articleTitle: Research on the influence of distributed photovoltaic grid connection on voltage fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous development and utilization of renewable energy, distributed photovoltaic (PV) connected to low voltage distribution network has become a new mode of power generation, and the gradual increase of photovoltaic permeability has a certain influence on the power quality of low voltage distribution network. The simulation model of distributed photovoltaic grid-connected system was established by MATLAB/Simulink simulation software, and the influence of distributed photovoltaic grid-connected system on power quality of distribution network was analyzed from the angle of voltage fluctuation. Static Synchronous Compensator (STATCOM) and PV inverter are combined to compensate the distribution network and suppress the fluctuation of grid voltage caused by the change of external conditions when distributed photovoltaic is connected to grid. The simulation results show that STATCOM and PV inverter have good suppression effect on voltage fluctuation when distributed photovoltaic is grid-connected, and the system model established is reasonable and effective.

articleTitle: Automatic Modeling and Optimization for The Digital twin of a Regional Multi-energy System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The penetration of renewable energy and multi-type energy increase in distribution system and traditional distribution system transforms into multi-energy systems. It demands an evolution for the management of the traditional distribution system operation and control. A multi-energy systems digital twin framework is proposed for the issue. The applications of system monitoring, dynamic planning, and real-time optimization are integrated with the proposed framework to facilitate the management of multi-energy systems. Additionally, a model generation automation process is implemented to guarantee the digital model in virtual space maps the physical system. The system parameter is calibrated with the automatic trigger mechanism of parameter optimization algorithm using historical operating data. The proposed model automation process and the parameter optimization algorithm was implemented based on the CloudPSS modeling and simulation platform. The model data includes geographic information, equipment information, and measurements. The implemented framework and methods were tested with a real-world multi-energy system at the Hong Feng Lake area of Guizhou, China. The testing results and system performance is analyzed.

articleTitle: Anomaly identification of critical power plant facilities based on YOLOX-CBAM
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the abnormal phenomena of steam leakage, oil leakage and water leakage in the key facilities of the power plant, this paper proposes an anomaly detection method based on YOLOX and improves the network and parameters, and the improved network can be better applied to the anomaly detection of power plants. YOLOX is an improved version of the YOLO series, using Anchor-Free, Mosaic, SimOTA and other methods to improve the network. This article adds CBAM (Convolutional Block Attention Module) on this basis and the final experiment shows that the mAP of the YOLOX-CBAM model is 2.7% higher than that of YOLOX and the detection speed is only 1.4 FPS slower.

articleTitle: Analysis of Energy Storage Configuration of Guangshui New Power System with New Energy Science and Technology Demonstration Project
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Building a new power system with new energy as the mainstay is one of the important ways to achieve carbon neutrality. State Grid Hubei Electric Power Co., LTD. is building Guangshui new power system with new energy science and technology demonstration project, which is located in Guangshui county, Suizhou city, Hubei province. In this paper, the basic situation of this demonstration project is introduced. The function of energy storage in this demonstration project is analyzed. The supporting effect of energy storage configuration on the stability of power grid in the demonstration area is researched. The effect of energy storage on the optimal operation of power grid in the demonstration area is studied. The cost of energy storage project in the demonstration area is estimated.

Author Keywords: new power system with new energy

articleTitle: Key Feature Selection Method for Intelligent Assessment of Transient Power Angle Stability based on Physical Mechanism and Improved Relief
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Key feature selection is of great significance for intelligent assessment of transient power angle stability of power system. This paper proposes a key feature selection method combining physical mechanism and improved Relief. The Relief index reflects the strength of the feature to classify transient power angle stability and instability. By eliminating redundancy and increasing the weight of unstable samples, the accuracy of index calculation and the ability to adapt to sample imbalance are improved. Through the combination of physical mechanism and improved Relief, the key feature quantities reflecting the stability of transient angle can be comprehensively selected by iterative optimization, and the problem of missing selection of key feature parameters under complex transient stability can be solved. The effectiveness of the method is verified by an actual power grid example.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Strategy of OLTC-Inverter in Distribution Transformer Area with High-proportion Residential Photovoltaics
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: However, the high penetration rate of residential PV grid connection will cause serious voltage overrun, and the coordinated control of PV inverter and OLTC can effectively solve the above problems. Aiming at the current situation that the coordinated control of inverter and OLTC in distribution station area is not studied enough, this paper proposes an OLTC and inverter coordinated control strategy and controller parameter optimization model. The OLTC-inverter voltage coordination control strategy is first proposed, and then the control parameters are optimally designed.

articleTitle: Research on Ice Accumulation of Transmission Lines in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The extreme weather conditions in Northwest China, especially in Xinjiang, are relatively complex and easily have an adverse impact on power grid safety, especially on high-voltage transmission lines, among which the impact of icing is the most prominent. This study analyzed the five forms of wire icing: rime, wet snow, mixed icing and frost. It was concluded that the main types of wire icing in Xinjiang were rime, and the extreme value appears to be highest in March. Variation characteristics of wire icing: the maximum thickness of wire icing in Xinjiang was generally between 21–66 mm, mostly between 30–45 mm. The distribution characteristics of rime and snow songs in Xinjiang were that the mountain area was more than the plain, and the wet area was more than the dry area. According to the extreme value I-type distribution, the recurrence level of the maximum icing thickness at 30 years, 50 years and 100 years was estimated, the ice area was divided, and the data were corrected by altitude, line diameter, special terrain and other parameters.

articleTitle: Data-driven equivalent inertia partition estimation of power systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing share of renewable energy and power electronics, the power system is gradually showing the characteristics of low inertia and spatial distribution. In order to accurately grasp the system inertia level, a data-driven equivalent inertia partition estimation method is proposed. First, frequency event sample data sets is built in batches considering a variety of typical operating scenarios. Next, according to the frequency response curve, the power grid is partitioned by the k-means algorithm based on dynamic time warping (DTW) distance. Then, the mapping between frequency response data and the system equivalent inertia is constructed based on the long short-term memory (LSTM) algorithm. Finally, the IEEE39 buses system simulation shows that the proposed method can reflect the spatial distribution characteristics of inertia with simple process, high accuracy, and good engineering applicability.

articleTitle: An Energy Storage Scheduling Strategy Based on Computational Optimization Starting Point
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With a large number of new energy sources connected to the grid, the inverse peak characteristics of their power generation have brought great difficulties to the grid scheduling. In recent years, energy storage technology has gradually developed and matured, and its dual characteristics of charge and discharge provide a new solution to the problem of new energy consumption. However, the current peak load shifting scheduling problem for energy storage is mainly solved by intelligent optimization algorithm, which has the disadvantage of low solving efficiency and the risk of falling into a local optimal solution. Therefore, this paper proposes a novel scheduling strategy based on computational optimization starting point for energy storage, which can provide an appropriate iterative starting point for intelligent optimization algorithm through the preset process. Compared with the randomly generated starting point, the calculated starting point can make the objective function tend to the extreme value more quickly and stably. Finally, in the case studies part, a system with solar power generation was taken as the example. The energy storage peak load shifting optimization problem was solved by adopting the calculated starting point and the random generated starting point respectively, and the effectiveness of the proposed strategy is proved by comparing the test results.

articleTitle: Optimized Operation of Virtual Power Plant Considering Multi-energy Demand Response under Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) aggregates large quantities of distributed energy resources (DERs), as well as flexible loads. The comprehensive consideration of demand response (DR) and carbon emissions has considerable significance in improving the VPP operation from the perspective of economy and low carbon. In this paper, a novel VPP model of considering multi-energy DR under carbon trading mechanism is studied. First, the energy flow mechanism of VPP is presented, and multi-energy demand response model considering reducible load, shiftable load and convertible load is introduced in VPP. Second, a carbon trading mechanism is proposed for VPP to purchase or sell carbon emission rights. Finally, a low-carbon economic dispatching model is proposed to achieve economic benefit and low carbon emission. Simulation results showed a 13.63% decrease in total cost for VPP and a 9.34% decrease in carbon emission.

articleTitle: Review of electric vehicles' charging data anomaly detection based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Anomalies in data may be caused by errors in the data, but sometimes the appearance of anomalous data often also suggests the emergence of a new domain or a new underlying process. Anomaly detection has therefore been an active area of research for decades. This paper is based on what anomaly detection is, the main areas of application for anomaly detection, and the challenges of anomaly detection at this stage. Deep learning-based anomaly detection is proposed based on the unpredictability, diversity, and sparsity that exist in anomaly detection, and deep learning anomaly detection algorithms are classified into unsupervised deep anomaly detection algorithms and semi-supervised deep anomaly detection algorithms based on the use of anomaly labels. This paper reviews and analyses the research on these two algorithms, and elaborates on the advantages and disadvantages of each type of anomaly detection algorithm when applied. Deep anomaly detection is also applied to the anomaly detection of charging data and is classified according to the different types of charging data, into deep anomaly detection for electric vehicles, deep anomaly detection for charging stations, and deep anomaly detection for charging poles. Finally, we provide an outlook on various algorithms for anomaly detection and future applications of anomaly detection in charging data.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Simulation and Optimal Scheduling Strategy Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing amount of information as well as the development of sensors in power system operation, the traditional simulation modeling of power system cannot meet the requirements of green intelligence in modern power systems. Digital twin technology can combine real physics with virtual space by machine learning and big data algorithm to build intelligent energy-oriented simulation system. In this paper, a combination of digital modeling and real-time simulation technology is used to construct a digital twin intelligent architecture for an integrated energy system. The twin data collected by the sensors are used for power prediction and multi-objective optimization and the pareto solution of the system was obtained by NSGA-II algorithm. Finally, the proposed scheduling strategy is verified and analyzed based on an industrial park, and the results show that the intelligent park can conduct reasonable scheduling and real-time interaction according to the digital twin optimization scheme.

articleTitle: Low-carbon economy energy use strategy for parks based on dynamic carbon emission factors
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the goal of “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” in China, low-carbon has become an inevitable trend of energy utilization, and it will be an important development direction in the future to guide the user-side clean and efficient energy use. With the development of the energy Internet, the park side has abundant controllable resources, which can help the power grid to carry out low-carbon emission reduction. In order to guide the low-carbon economic energy use of the park, this paper constructs a multi-objective energy management framework for the park under the new power system environment, and comprehensively manages the controllable equipment in the park from the perspective of economy and low-carbon. An energy consumption model considering the electricity cost and carbon emission of the park is constructed, and the dynamic carbon emission factor of the park is constructed based on the electricity-carbon information. Considering the instability of carbon emissions caused by the intermittent and fluctuating power consumption of controllable equipment in the park, the constraints of low-carbon operation and power balance in the park are constructed, so that the controllable equipment can participate in carbon energy management. The multi-objective solution algorithm Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-II (NSGA-II) is used to solve the low-carbon economy energy consumption model. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper can effectively manage the energy consumption and improve the low-carbon economy operation level of the park.

Author Keywords: low-carbon economic energy use in the park

articleTitle: Current control of the LCL-type grid-connected inverter based on improved reduced-order extended state observer
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The grid-connected inverter (GCI) with the LCL type is a crucial device for achieving energy flow between distributed generation (DG) and the power grid. To achieve error-free control of the GCI grid-side current, the abc/dq transformation is used to convert the static coordinate frame to the synchronous coordinate frame, although this transformation suffers from the coupling problem between the dq frames. An improved reduced-order extended state observer (I-RESO) for grid-side current control is proposed in this paper, which solves the complex decoupling procedure of conventional methods by treating the coupling of the dq frames as part of the total disturbance and using I-RESO for real-time observation and compensation. Meanwhile, to address the problem that the conventional reduced-order ESO method requires differentiation of the output, which introduces high-frequency noise. This paper adopts a method to achieve the reduced order of ESO without differentiating the output, which solves the problem of noise introduction and improves the dynamic performance of current control. The viability and effectiveness of the proposed strategy are verified by simulation.

Author Keywords: Improved reduced order extended state observer

articleTitle: Robot Path Planning Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Path planning is one of the research hotspots of today's robotics. This paper makes some improvements in allusion to the issue that particle swarm has poor local search ability and sinks into local optimum easily in robot path planning. In this method, the inflection point factor is introduced into the fitness function to cut down the number of turns and accelerate the convergence of the algorithm, and a new adaptive and dynamically adjusted inertia weight is adopted to adjust the local and global search capabilities of particles, so as to avert sinking into the suboptimization prematurely and improve the search quality. Experimental comparison results indicate that the algorithm can improve the quality of particle search in the early and late stage, so that an optimal path can be planned more quickly and effectively.

articleTitle: Power quality analysis of wind-storage combined system connected to power grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous connection of large-scale wind farms and the wide application of energy storage, the power quality problems have attracted more and more attention. This paper proposes calculation methods and steps for the power quality index caused by the integration of the wind-storage combined system into the power grid. According to an example of a wind-storage system, combined with technical parameters of devices, the analysis and calculation program ETAP is used to analyze and evaluate the power quality problems.

articleTitle: Day-ahead Bidding Strategy for Electric Vehicles and Wind Power Participating in Energy and Frequency Regulation Market
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient consideration of the interaction between electric vehicles and wind power bidding in energy and frequency regulation (FR) market, a day-ahead bidding model for electric vehicle aggregator (EVA) and wind power supplier (WPS) participating in energy-FR market is established in this paper. Firstly, the bidding framework for the energy-FR market is designed. Then, combined with the bidding model of electric vehicle aggregator considering battery loss, a day-ahead bidding strategy for EVA and WPS participating in the energy-FR market is proposed and a Nash-Stackelberg game model that takes into account the three-party of EVA, WPS and electricity trading center is established. Finally, the simulation results verify the rationality of the proposed strategy. The market clearing results secure the benefits of EVA and WPS.

articleTitle: The performance experiment of an air-source heat pump with multi-stage waste heat recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To improve the efficiency of the air-source heat pump system and improve the stability of operation, the experimental prototype of an air source heat pump system with multi-stage waste heat recovery is independently designed and processed, and the performance of the heat pump system is studied in Xi'an area as an example. The heat pump outlet's heat air temperature is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{40^{\circ}C, 45^{\circ}C}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{50^{\mathrm{o}}C}$</tex> respectively. Combined with the operation modes of 5 heat pump systems, the performance test of 15 sets of heat pump system experimental prototypes is tested. The experimental results show that the multi-stage waste heat recovery subsystem can effectively improve the COP of the air source heat pump experimental prototype. When the set temperature of the air outlet is <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{50^{\mathrm{o}}C}$</tex>, the energy efficiency of the multi-stage air source heat pump system for waste heat recovery can be increased by 22.2% compared with the COP air source heat pump, and the heat recovery rate of the waste heat recovery system can be up to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{88\%\sim 94\%}$</tex>. With the increase in ambient temperature, the COP of the heat pump system increases significantly under each working condition. The indoor control mode under different outdoor temperatures also restricts the unit's performance. The overall performance of the heat pump experimental prototype is relatively best when the two-stage and three-stage heat recovery are connected in series with the first-stage heat recovery working mode. From the perspective of stable operation and maintenance of the air source heat pump system, the first-stage heat recovery and the working mode of three-stage heat recovery in series is more suitable, and the indoor heating effect of the heat pump experimental prototype is relatively stable.

articleTitle: Research on Resonance Problem of Multi-power Converters in DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the DC microgrid, the power converter is the core device with the highest proportion in the system, and its characteristics also dominate the characteristics of the DC microgrid. Due to the lack of traditional generator sets in the DC microgrid, low inertia and weak damping also become the system main output characteristics. After research, it is found that after many power converters are connected to the DC microgrid, they will be affected by the line impedance and even the constant power load, and then the interaction will cause the DC bus voltage to resonate and collapse. Aiming at this problem, this paper proposes a method for analyzing the voltage resonance of the DC microgrid bus voltage based on the impedance model by constructing the impedance model of the DC microgrid, which effectively explains the generation mechanism of the resonance. Finally, the DC microgrid model is established in the simulation software, and the accuracy of the analysis method proposed in this paper is verified.

articleTitle: Impact of Carbon Trading Market on Photovoltaic Power Generation under Grid Parity Policy
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The development of photovoltaic power generation projects is an important way to achieve the “carbon peak and neutrality ” goal, and project of photovoltaic power generation are facing huge problems under the policy of grid parity. The project of photovoltaic power generation participate in the carbon trading market, which can reduce carbon emissions and can increase project revenue. From the perspective of benefits and costs, the impact of the carbon trading market on project of photovoltaic power generation participate is studied. In the research on the carbon trading market, the ARIMA model is used to predict the carbon trading price. The model has the accuracy and stability of the carbon trading price forecast, This minimizes the impact on photovoltaic power generation projects due to insufficient prediction accuracy in the process of predicting carbon trading prices. The results show that participation of the project of photovoltaic power generation participate in the carbon trading market can effectively solve the economic problems they face.

articleTitle: Research on Black-start Zoning Method for Maximum Power Recovery
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Reasonable network partitioning schemes for black start restoration after large scale blackout of a power system can increase the restoration efficiency and shorten the duration of the restoration process. In this paper, an evaluation method of new energy as black start power supply is proposed, which comprehensively considers the uncertainty of new energy output, the capacity of energy storage configuration and the recovery time constraint of non-black start unit. The number of grid black start power supplies has been increased. At the same time, combining the state of non-black start units in the power grid, the structure of the grid and the electrical constraints in the power grid restoration process, a black start zoning method for maximum power restoration is proposed. The IEEE 39-bus system is used for validation of the optimization algorithm.

articleTitle: Low Frequency Oscillation Mode Identification Algorithm Based on VMD Noise Reduction and Stochastic Subspace Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Low-frequency oscillation (LFO) is a security and stability issue that the power system focuses on, measurement data play an important role in online monitoring and analysis of low-frequency oscillation parameters. Aiming at the problem that the measurement data containing noise affects the accuracy of modal parameter identification, a VMD-SSI modal identification algorithm is proposed, which uses the variational modal decomposition algorithm (VMD) for noise reduction combined with the stochastic subspace algorithm for identification. The VMD algorithm decomposes and reconstructs the initial signal with certain noise, and filters out the noise signal. Then, the optimized signal is input into stochastic subspace identification algorithm(SSI), the modal parameters is obtained. Simulation of a three-machine ninenode system verifies that the VMD-SSI mode identification algorithm has good anti-noise performance.

articleTitle: Multi – objective Cluster Partition Method for Distribution Network Considering Uncertainties of Distributed Generations and Loads
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The intermittence and fluctuation of distributed new energy and load make the cluster partition of the distribution network more difficult. In order to obtain more applicable grid clusters, a multi-objective cluster partition method considering the uncertainty of sources and loads is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the source-load uncertainty model is constructed to obtain the typical scenario of source-load, and the typical scenario is used to characterize the system uncertainty. Secondly, a multi-objective cluster partition model with cluster economic cost, net power complementarity, control dimension and corresponding constraints is constructed. Then, in view of the contradictory nature of each objective, the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm and fuzzy membership function are used to obtain the optimal cluster results. Through the example simulation of the modified IEEE 33 node and compared with the clustering method without considering uncertainty. The results show that the cluster obtained by this method has the characteristics of low control dimension, reasonable resource allocation and low economic cost.

articleTitle: A Local Cascade Ensemble Learning Method for Lithium Ion Battery SOC Estimation under Multi External Factors Considering OCV Hysteresis
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of hard adaptability and poor dynamic response of traditional state of charge (SoC) estimation methods, data-driven methods are adopted. In order to reduce the variance and deviation in the estimation process and make full use of the respective merits of bagging and boosting, a data-driven local cascade ensemble learning method is proposed to battery SoC estimation. Firstly, to achieve data-driven SoC estimation, the relationship between open circuit voltage (OCV) and SoC is analyzed. The effect of OCV hysteresis on SoC is discussed. Then, for the traditional SoC estimation methods difficult to consider hysteresis effect, a data-driven ensemble learning model is established to estimate SoC using relationship between OCV and SoC. Meanwhile, the form of local cascade based on random and extreme gradient boosting is adopted to minimize variance and deviation of estimation. Finally, the effectiveness and adaptability of the proposed method is verified by dataset from the built experimental bench under different external factors (temperature effect and mechanical stress). The results demonstrate that the proposed method can accurately estimate SoC under different external factors.

articleTitle: The accuracy improvement method for Partial discharge UHF measurement data based on Kalman filter algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For PD detection, localisation, and analysis, precise measurement of partial discharge (PD) ultra-high frequency (UHF) data is essential. The UHF signals obtained are typically not accurate enough due to the complicated field electromagnetic noise environment and the capabilities of measurement devices. In order to increase the accuracy of UHF signal measurement, the Kalman filter technique will be used in this study. The UHF signal amplitude is processed using the Kalman filter technique to lessen variation and measurement error. The suggested technique is also used to the widely utilized MUSIC method for PD localization in order to test its efficacy. The experimental results demonstrate that the suggested approach may successfully increase the accuracy of UHF measurements because the angle of arrival (AOA) results from MUSIC combined with the Kalman filter algorithm are within 5 degrees.

articleTitle: Optimal Capacity Allocation of Combined Output of Tower Gravity Energy Storage Power Station and Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To solve the capacity planning problem of wind power energy storage hybrid system, a capacity planning method of tower gravity energy storage power station based on factor analysis is proposed. Considering the multi-objective complexity of capacity optimization of tower energy storage power station, a comprehensive evaluation index system for capacity planning of tower gravity energy storage power station is established. The evaluation index system takes the highest total score as the goal, considering the randomness of wind power output and the economy of grid-connected operation of gravity energy storage system. By solving the evaluation index values of different capacities, the factor analysis method is used to reduce the dimension of each capacity index value, and the optimal planning capacity of gravity energy storage power station is determined. The calculation results of evaluation indexes, factor variance contribution rate and rotation component matrix of energy storage power plants with different capacity are given. The wind power output and energy storage capacity can be reasonably arranged through the comprehensive score of planning capacity, which can provide the optimal planning capacity of wind power energy storage combined system for technicians.

articleTitle: Steady-State Modeling of Hybrid Unified Power Flow Controller with Additional Nodes
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The hybrid unified power flow controller (HUPFC) consists of a “Sen” transformer (ST) and a unified power flow controller (UPFC) in series. It not only has the same control function of line power flow as the UPFC but also has a lower cost and less loss. In order to evaluate the application value of HUPFC in practical engineering, it is necessary to realize the power flow calculation of the system containing HUPFC. However, the relevant model has not been developed yet. Regarding the issue above, this paper proposes a steady-state mathematical model of HUPFC with additional nodes, which can quickly build an interface with commercial software. First, according to the topology of HUPFC, the series side is equivalent to a voltage source and impedance, the parallel side is equivalent to a current source, and it introduces additional nodes to establish a simplified equivalent circuit of HUPFC. Second, the voltage source is converted into additional power to the node and establishes the HUPFC power injection model. Finally, calculate the HUPFC controllable voltage source voltage according to the control objective, then obtain the UPFC and ST control parameters. Simulation examples verify the accuracy and validity of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Short-Term Load Forecasting Based on Radam Optimized CNN-BiLSTM-AE Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Reliable short term load forecasting (STLF) is significant in the operation and planning of power systems. With the increasing demand for the accuracy of load prediction in modern society, neural network models are basically regarded as the mainstream model in the field of load prediction. However, based on a single AI model, the algorithm cannot adequately capture the potential characteristics of the load sequence. In the following study, we proposed a CNN-BiLSTM-AE model to improve the accuracy of load prediction further. The model applies the convolution layer of CNN to capture the spatial feature of power load data, and BiLSTM is used to capture temporal features that satisfy the power load data. Both the short and the long time series are input into the encoder, which can abstract features of diverse degrees and produce latent vectors related to them. Then, the input sequence is rebuilt in the decoder to guarantee that the potential vectors are meaningful and improve the exactness of short-term prediction. In order to further enhance the accuracy of prediction, a new optimizer Radam and attention mechanism are proposed in the experiment.

articleTitle: Study on the Participation of Virtual Power Plants with Demand Response in Peaking Auxiliary Services
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The introduction of “carbon peaking and carbon neutral” has brought new development opportunities for clean energy development, but the volatility of clean energy output has led to a growing demand for peaking resources. The integration of load-side resources for peaking is a proven solution to this problem, and virtual power plant (VPP) technology is a common means to integrate load-side resources. The paper develops physical and market models of generation facilities such as thermal units, energy storage and demand response. Then, in order to maximize the overall profitability of VPP, a peaking market clearing model is developed, which takes into account the aggregation of generation resources by VPP. Finally, simulations based on this model were conducted to explore the clearing results of the peaking market and the profitability of VPP under different scenarios. The analysis shows that VPP can integrate the advantages of various generating units, unlock the peaking potential of flexible resources, and reduce the peaking cost of the system. At the same time, the total revenue is significantly improved after forming a VPP to participate in the peaking market, and the VPP operator and the power system achieve a win-win situation.

articleTitle: Modeling of Output Power for Vehicle Charging System by improved K-means-LS-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This research developed a charging system model based on an improved k-means-LS-SVM algorithm to deal with the influence of large-scale electric vehicle (EV) charging on grid dispatch. Firstly, we generated the output curve of the charging system by preprocessing the historical charging order data of the charging system. Second, we clustered the charging system's output curves using the improved K-means technique, resulting in a new data set of output curves that contained charging systems with comparable date clustering types for the three days before the test day and the test day. Finally, the photovoltaic output value of the test data was calculated by the LS-SVM algorithm. The results of the calculation example show that the improved k-means model combined with the LS-SVM algorithm can obtain better results in the output of the charging system. It is feasible to use the algorithm for establishing the charging system's output model.

Author Keywords: output model of the charging system

articleTitle: Integrated control method of energy storage participating in primary frequency regulation under deep peak regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: According to the system frequency regulation requirements under deep peak regulation(DPR) condition, a integrated control method of energy storage participating in primary frequency regulation(PFR) under DPR condition is proposed.By analyzing the influence of the virtual droop control and virtual inertia control of the energy storage battery on the grid frequency, the improved virtual negative inertia control is proposed. In order to prevent the energy storage battery from frequently charging and discharging, this method considers the dead zone of energy storage frequency regulation, sets the safety boundary conditions of the system.On this basis, in order to ensure the maintenance effect of the state of charge (SOC) of the energy storage battery, an adaptive control law of SOC feedback is proposed.Finally, SIMULINK is used to simulate and verify the typical power grid, and the results show that the proposed method can not only improve the grid frequency effectively under the condition of DPR,but also maintain SOC level well.

Author Keywords: energy storage frequency modulation dead zone

articleTitle: Optical Character Recognition of Electrical Equipment Nameplate with Contrast Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Automatic identification of the electrical equipment via optical character recognition (OCR) of the electrical equipment nameplate images has been widely used as a primary inspection task of a substation. However, most existing OCR methods assume that the input image is obtained under ideal ambient lighting conditions and only focus on text detection and recognition. This commonly results in poor OCR performance when dealing with images with, e.g., reflection effects that are captured under complex ambient light conditions. In this paper, we propose an OCR system that can reliably handle the common reflection effects shown in the electrical equipment nameplate images captured under challenging ambient light conditions. Specifically, we did this by applying a robust contrast enhancement method that is based on a logarithmic mapping function (LMF) to the electrical equipment nameplate images prior to OCR with one of the state-of-the-art OCR networks, PPOCRv3. Experimental results with 24 test electrical equipment nameplate images show that the LMF contrast enhancement not only improves the image quality in terms of the lighting condition and overall scene statistics but also improves the overall OCR sentence recognition accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on defect identification of key components of transmission line based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that a large number of images generated by UAV(unmanned aerial vehicle) during power inspection need to be interpreted manually, which is time-consuming and laborious. With the continuous increase of data, it is difficult to meet the requirements of accuracy and real-time with the naked eye, a deep learning algorithm is proposed to automatically identify the defects of key components of power transmission line, such as insulator, pressure connecting pipe and so on. Firstly, the data sets of insulator and tension line clamp and pressure connecting pipe are established, and then two deep neural networks, Faster R-CNN and YOLOv3, are used to build models with different front-end networks. A total of five models are built. During model training, the pre training model is used to improve the training speed, and the sample amplification technology is used to improve the accuracy of the model. The results show that the Faster R-CNN-Resnet18 model has the best effect, and the average accuracy (map) of all recognition objects on the test set is more than 0.87.

articleTitle: Research on the construction technology of grid dispatching platform based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing complexity of business application types in power grid, multi-source power grid business information presents the characteristics of large capacity and low value density, and the power grid dispatching business process is becoming more and more complicated. In this environment, the traditional empirical dispatching mode has low efficiency and weak cooperation, which is difficult to meet the needs of modern power grid dispatching operation. Therefore, this paper proposes a dispatching decision support technology based on artificial intelligence technology and relying on power big data drive. Through intelligent human-computer interaction method, it can intelligently identify, judge and extract key dispatching business information, and summarize different regional business into a unified power grid intelligent dispatching platform. Under the support of the platform, the complex business pattern recognition problem can be effectively simplified and solved. The technical advantages of artificial intelligence are deeply integrated with the requirements of power grid dispatching operation, so as to better support the ubiquitous intelligent application of power grid dispatching, power trading, accident exception handling and other regulation business.

articleTitle: Image recognition and processing model of multi-circuit lines on the same tower based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The erection of multi-circuit transmission lines on the same tower can effectively improve the utilization efficiency of power corridors, and is increasingly used in power grid construction planning. But at the same time, the difficulty of live maintenance of multi-circuit transmission lines on the same tower is gradually presented to power grid builders. Aiming at the problems of large workload and low efficiency in manual identification of defective images in the process of UAV(Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) patrolling transmission lines application needs. Taking advantage of the convenience of UAV to inspect power lines, the system structure of the UAV stereo intelligent inspection application platform based on UAV image recognition is explored. Image or video data for preprocessing recognition. At the same time, the position of the image defect is marked and the type is classified, and the recognition result is fed back.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Time of Use Pricing Strategy for the Net-Zero Microgrid Considering Uncertainty in Loads and Renewable Energy Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The phenomenon that the utilization of conventional energy resources poses significant pollution problems to environment makes the realization of nearly net-zero Microgrids (MGs) imminent. Based on such context, this paper presents a time-of-use (TOU) pricing strategy for the net-zero MG in considering uncertainty in residential load, wind power and photovoltaic (PV) power. The multi-objective of the proposed model mainly includes minimizing the load variance, maximizing the rate of user satisfaction and minimizing the proportion of users abandoning renewable energy resources. The linear function of elastic price on user demand is utilized to optimize the TOU electricity price. The non-dominated sorting NSGA-II algorithm is leveraged to solve the TOU electricity price. The simulation results show that the proposed TOU pricing strategy is beneficial for both energy consumers and renewable energy resources, which facilitates a sustainable net-zero MGs eventually.

articleTitle: A Leakage Current-Free Photovoltaic Inverter and Its Control Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Light weight, small size, high efficiency as non-isolated PV grid-connected inverter advantages. Still, there is an electrical connection between the PV cells and the grid in non-isolated PV grid-connected inverters, which quickly generates large leakage currents to the ground. The standard mode leakage current will cause grid-connected current distortion and additional losses and threaten personal safety. In addition, the traditional bridge inverter has the problem of bridge arm straight-through, which renders the system less stable. A dual grounded leakage current-free PV inverter is proposed to address the above problems. The inverter topology consists of a Buck-Boost circuit and a DBHB circuit, with PWM control for the Buck-Boost circuit and hysteresis loop current control for the DBHB circuit. This inverter has no common-mode leakage current and does not lead to bridge arm straight-through. The analysis of the simulation proves the feasibility and effectiveness of the topology.

articleTitle: Charge-discharge control modeling of electric vehicle cluster based on SOC state interval aggregate load
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Large-scale electric vehicle clusters connected to the grid have fast and objective Adjustable capability. The existing charging and discharging control methods for electric vehicle clusters are modeled and solved for a single electric vehicle. The model is complex and the amount of calculation is large. At the same time, a large number of independent control signals bring communication problems. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a charge and discharge control model of electric vehicle cluster based on aggregated load in SOC state interval. Firstly, the aggregated load model of the SOC state interval of the electric vehicle cluster is described by Markov chain; then, four states and five state switching instructions are introduced considering the interests of multi-agents, and the charge and discharge control model of the electric vehicle aggregated load is constructed. Finally, the improved genetic algorithm is used to solve the calculation example to obtain the charging and discharging control strategy of the electric vehicle cluster in a certain area, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed modeling method and control method.

Author Keywords: aggregated load in SOC state interval

articleTitle: Fire Risk Assessment of Electric bicycles Charging Facilities in Old Urban Communities
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The frequent fire accidents caused by electric bicycles would seriously threaten urban safety. In this paper, an index system for fire risk assessment of electric bicycles charging facilities in old urban communities was established based on accident cases and the relevant laws, regulations and standards. The index weight coefficients were determined by Delphi method, and the improved Safety Checklist was used to perform risk assessment of charging facilities in old communities. The case analysis showed that this method can effectively assess the fire risk of electric bicycles charging facilities in old communities, and help to put forward the specific measures.

articleTitle: Overview of Steady-state Modeling and Optimal Operation of Power System with FACTS
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of power grid and renewable energy, power flow over-limit has become an increasingly serious problem which threats security and stability of the system. Flexible alternating current transmission systems (FACTS) provide flexible adjustment of the network structure and parameters, which improve transmitted power of lines and enhance stable operation of the system. It is important to utilize the maximum ability of FACTS devices and achieve optimal operation of the power system. Typical and the most powerful FACTS devices, unified power flow controller (UPFC), interline power flow controller (IPFC) and hybrid power flow controller (HPFC), are firstly introduced, topologies and characteristics are also summarized. Secondly, different equivalent models of FACTS are introduced, and their characteristics are discussed. Finally, models and solution methods for optimal operation of the system with FACTS are introduced, then the direction for further research is prospected.

articleTitle: A Current Sharing Strategy with Wide Input/Output Range for Series Capacitor DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Currently series capacitor DC-DC converter (SCDC) is widely used in high gain applications. Whether traditional average phase-shift control or 180° phase-shift control, however, multiphase SCDC cannot achieve current sharing of each phase over the whole duty cycle range, which limits its use in wide input/output applications. To solve this issue, an extended duty cycle current sharing strategy based on 180° phase-shift control is proposed in this paper. Adopting this strategy, SCDC can achieve current sharing among phases and consistent voltage gain expression over the whole duty cycle range. In this paper, three-phase SCDC is chosen to demonstrate the proposed strategy. In addition, the current sharing characteristics, voltage gain and switching stresses of three-phase SCDC are analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the current sharing strategy is validated by the prototype experiment.

articleTitle: Influence of Cable Fire Protection Measures on Current Carrying Capacity
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electric energy has become more and more important in modern society. The frequent occurrence of cable fire accidents makes people begin to pay more attention to the fire protection measures of cables and study their influence on the current carrying capacity. This paper briefly describes the cable fire prevention measures, and studies the influence of cable fire prevention measures on the current carrying capacity, and gives the influence of cable fire prevention, fire strip, fire blocking, and fire partition (wall) on the current carrying capacity.

articleTitle: Research on Quantitative Calculation Method of Power System Flexibility Requirement Based on Flexible Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Conventional quantitative methods of power system flexibility demand mainly focus on load uncertainty and unit fault reserve capacity determination method, which is difficult to ensure the flexible and safe operation of power system with large-scale volatile power supply access. This paper establishes a quantitative model of flexibility demand considering uncertainty, volatility and correlation of new energy output. A method of power system flexibility analysis based on flexibility calculation is proposed. The correctness and effectiveness of the model are verified by an example. Compared with the flexible demand quantitative analysis method based on multi unit or net load fluctuation, it proposes a demand quantitative analysis method based on flexible calculation, which can meet the requirements of a high proportion of new energy power system by setting additional load reserves.

articleTitle: Research on fault prediction and diagnosis of power equipment based on big data
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of smart grid and the rapid expansion of power grid scale, it is very difficult to grasp the operational state of power equipment timely and accurately. Combined with the current status of the application of big data technology and data mining analysis methods in equipment status assessment, this paper expounds the connotation and purpose, data sources and characteristics, basic framework and key technical issues involved in big data analysis of power equipment status, and summarizes and discusses big data. Typical application scenarios and application effects of technology in power equipment status assessment, and propose challenges in research and application as well as future development trends.

articleTitle: Hierarchical control architecture for networked synchronization of multi-microgrids
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A hierarchical control architecture for networked synchronization of multi-microgrids based on dispatchable virtual oscillator control (dVOC) is proposed, including steady-state control layer and dynamic control layer. The steady-state control layer can realize that the operating frequency of each sub-microgrid is consistent and the phase and amplitude of the voltage at point of common coupling (PCC) reach the set values, so that the whole multi-micro grid system converges to the stable operation point associated with the specific power scheduling instruction. The dynamic control layer can realize the fast and accurate regulation of the PCC voltage, frequency and phase of each sub-microgrid and ensure the high-precision distribution of output power of each distributed generation (DG) inside. The proposed control architecture realizes the flatness of the multi-microgrid control, avoids the restriction of the multi-layer control structure on the dynamic performance of the system, reduces the communication complexity to a certain extent and improves the reliability of the system. The effectiveness of the proposed hierarchical control architecture is verified by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: A typical scenario generation method for active distribution network based on Wasserstein distance
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy such as wind power and solar power and the rapid popularization of electric vehicles, the operation and planning of active distribution network needs to consider the consequent uncertainties. To solve this problem, a generation algorithm of typical scenario based on Wasserstein probability distance is proposed. The algorithm first transforms the continuous probability density functions of wind power / solar power / electric vehicle output at a single time into the discrete quantiles containing precise probability information through the Wasserstein probability distance index. Then, considering the amount of calculation and its probability loss, the scheduling interval is divided into several sub intervals. The kmeans cluster algorithm is used to reduce the amount of the typical scenario in the interval, and the Cartesian product connection is used between the intervals. Through analyzing the cluster validity index, proposes two indexes of intra-class compactness and interclass separation, and the optimal clustering number is determined according to the class effectiveness index. Through iterative scenario reduction and fragment mergence operations, a typical scenario is finally formed. Finally, an IEEE 33 bus distribution network is taken as an example to verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm, The results show that the proposed typical scenario set has better effectiveness and reduction degree.

articleTitle: Highly Reliable Dual-ground Lift-voltage PV Grid-connected Inverter
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As the conventional non-isolated PV inverter suffers from bridge arm straight-through and common mode leakage current problems. To address these problems, a highly reliable non-isolated double-grounded grid-connected PV inverter is investigated. The inverter operates in three modes - Buck, Boost, and Buck-Boost within one cycle of the grid. thus improving the efficiency of the system. The operating principle of the inverter and the control strategy of this topology is described, and finally, the theoretical analysis is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Effects of coupled accumulator with gas-liquid separator on an air source heat pump
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The outdoor heat exchanger is easy to frost when an air source heat pump (ASHP) is heating in winter. As the most common defrosting method, reverse cycle defrosting (RCD) has the problems of defrosting with liquid and long-time defrosting. To better solve the problem of RCD, a novel ASHP coupled with coupled accumulator with gas-liquid separator is proposed. A mathematical model of coupled accumulator with gas-liquid separator was established to simulate the influence of inlet temperature of gaseous and liquid refrigerant, the influence of heat transfer area of the coupled accumulator with gas-liquid separator on COP, and the influence of outdoor air temperature and humidity on frost thickness. Results show that the heat transfer effect in the coupled accumulator with gas-liquid separator is better when the outdoor air temperature is 5°C and the relative humidity is 90%. When the heat transfer area in the cavity of the gas-liquid separator is larger than 0.18m2, the COP increases slowly. The frost thickness reaches the maximum when the outdoor air temperature is 5°C and the relative humidity is 90%. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Design of non-dispersive infrared (NDIR) SF6 gas monitoring system based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Design of non-dispersive infrared SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas on-line monitoring system based on the principle that the measured gas absorbs infrared radiation of a specific wavelength, The good nonlinear mapping and generalization ability of the RBF neural network is used to compensate the measurement error caused by the detection of ambient temperature changes. The experimental results show that the monitoring system can measure the SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas concentration in real time accurately, quickly and in real time.

articleTitle: Research on voltage optimization under the time-varying characteristics of renewable energy and load
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Reasonable reactive power and voltage control can greatly lower energy loss during transmission while also increasing the power grid's voltage qualification rate. The comprehensive utilization of various distributed equipment that can regulate reactive power and voltage of power system and the implementation of reactive power global centralized optimization control can effectively improve the voltage quality while ensuring the security and stability of the power grid operation. At present, AVC can only control the current operation state of the power grid. In essence, it is the real-time control after finding that the voltage exceeds the limit or the reactive power flow distribution is unreasonable. In the case of renewable energy and load active power fluctuation, failure to effectively deal with the requirements of the reactive power balancing and voltage control on the grid will lead to frequent repeated adjustment of the equipment, affect the service life of the equipment, and seriously endanger the safe and stable operation of the power grid. With the massive connection of renewable energy sources and the mixed operation of AC and DC power grid, uncertainties on both the source and load side increases, the dynamic characteristics of power grid are complex and changeable, and the problem of reactive power and the regulation of power supply and voltage become more and more prominent. Hence, it makes sense to study the dynamic reactive power optimal dispatching control technology of AC / DC power grid. Considering the change trend of renewable energy and load, comprehensively coordinate reactive power and voltage equipment such as flexible DC, SVC, generator reactive power, capacitive reactor and OLTC to carry out multi cycle coupling dynamic reactive power optimization. Complete scheduling cycle. In this way, the fine control of reactive power and voltage can be realized.

articleTitle: Coordinated control study of optical storage DC microgrid system
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In pursuit of maximise the use of distributed renewable energy and to control loads with fluctuating demand better, an energy management and coordination policy is presented for a DC microgrid consisting of solar power generation, energy conservation system, resistive load and constant power load. Firstly, the paper pose the system construction and running mode of the DC microgrid; Secondly, different strategies are used to guarantee the stability of the system by controlling the converters in a coordinated manner, and the secondary control based on mixture compensation is utilized to achieve bus voltage reliability and load matching in the system in view of the problems of voltage drop and parallel current equalization in the traditional droop control; Finally, the fluctuation of output power of PV units and load variation occurring in the operation are investigated. Finally, the simulation of the output power fluctuation and load variation of the PV power generation unit is verified in MATLAB/Simulink. The results demonstrate that the proposed control policy can restrain the volatile DC bus voltage, reasonably distribute the power output of each generation unit. Besides, it can improve the reliability and stability of the system, and verify the effectiveness and feasibility of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Load forecasting model of power grid based on EWM and GRA-ELM
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the prediction accuracy of load at the time and space scale is low in the current process of power grid operation, in order to improve the power grid's ability to predict the accuracy of load, this paper proposes an entropy weight method (EVM), grey relational analysis (GRA) and extreme learning machine (ELM) combined load forecasting method. First, through the study of various types of community load energy, population, economic conditions and other data in the area, the main characteristics of different types of loads are analyzed, and a load density index system is established; Then, EVM and GAR are used respectively to realize the weight distribution of various types of load indicators, and the selection of samples with similar load densities in the area to be measured; Finally, the particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to process and train the relevant parameters of the ELM to realize the calculation of the density of the area to be measured. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the load forecasting model proposed in this paper are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Output Forecast of Waste Lead-acid Battery in Power Grid Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Waste lead-acid batteries are a kind of hazardous waste, and China attaches great importance to the pollution control of their recycling and treatment. In this paper, we use the historical data of installed power generation capacity which has strong correlation with the waste lead-acid batteries of power grid enterprises, select several modeling methods which meet the characteristics of these historical data, model and analyze these historical data respectively, and compare the prediction values of several methods, select the prediction method with better prediction accuracy, establish the prediction method to get the model, and consider the factors affecting the model to modify the model. The prediction results of the model are made more in line with the actual development, and the prediction of the output of used lead-acid batteries in power grid enterprises is scientific and operable.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation Optimization of PV-and-storage Microgrid Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The randomness and volatility of distributed photovoltaic output have brought adjustment to the safe operation of microgrid. Reasonable photovoltaic-energy storage capacity allocation and demand side response can stabilize the volatility of photovoltaic. Thus, this paper establishes an optimal capacity allocation method of photovoltaic-energy storage of grid-connected microgrid considering demand response. Firstly, considering the uncertainty of photovoltaic generation, a two-stage capacity allocation model of microgrid photovoltaic-energy storage considering the characteristics of shiftable load is proposed. Then, based on the historical scenarios of photovoltaic generation and scenario reduction, the model is solved by stochastic optimization method. Finally, an example is given to verify the feasibility of the method and the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Robot path planning based on the improved grey wolf optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A modified grey wolf optimization algorithm for the path planning of mobile robots is proposed, for the slow convergence speed and high search path cost. Establish two-dimensional space model of mobile robot obstacle avoidance path planning, convert linear convergence factors in the grey wolf optimization algorithm into non-linear convergence factor; add collaborative quantum optimization of grey wolf population; and use four international test functions to prove that the improved algorithm is better in terms of convergence accuracy and stability. The improved algorithm was applied to the path planning of the mobile robot and compared with the original algorithm to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Energy Storage Using a Sequence Representative Period Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing penetration of renewable energy sources, the system requires more energy storage capacity to relieve the pressure on peak shaving. Developing more flexible and rational approaches to energy storage capacity planninng is becoming increasingly important. This paper proposes a novel two-stage optimal planning model for energy storage based on a sequence representative period approach, which takes into account the uncertainty of wind power and load, as well as short-term intra-day operation mechanisms. The approach relies on a temporal sequence of each day and adds coupling constraints related to long-term scheduling among representative days in order to incorporate a long-term strategy on short-term operation. Case studies on revised IEEE 14-bus test systems are performed to verify the validity of the proposed model and approach.

articleTitle: Research on three-phase grid-connected inverter control system with voltage tracking and anti-disturbance performance
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Given that the traditional three-phase LCL-type grid-connected inverter controller needs an accurate mathematical model to have good control performance, this paper introduces the Differential Flatness-based Control (FBC) strategy into the power outer-loop controller of grid-connected inverter, which does not need accurate mathematical model and has good tracking ability. In addition, the Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (LADRC) is introduced on the basis of the FBC to improve the influence of inverter coupling and uncertain disturbance on the system, and the anti-disturbance capability of LADRC is also analyzed. The simulation results under different working conditions based on MATLAB/Simulink software show that the proposed FBC+LADRC control strategy not only has good voltage tracking ability, but also has good current output ability in the case of grid voltage amplitude disturbance.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Fan Parameters to Increase the Cooling Efficiency of the Engine Radiator
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The article discusses the optimization of fan parameters. Optimization is carried out in order to increase the cooling efficiency of the engine radiator. First, the measurement and construction of the original fan VAZ 21214-1300024-43 is carried out, which is used to cool the real engine. Construction and calculation are carried out in the Ansys Workbench software package. Then, taking into account the identified shortcomings, the fan is calculated and optimized in the Ansys software package. According to the results of the calculations, as well as the results of the analysis, several variants of fans were obtained, with a different number of blades, different power parameters, the degree of pressure increase, air flow, etc. From the options obtained, the most effective ones were selected.

articleTitle: A New Multi-objective Hybrid Algorithm For Dynamic Environmental Economic Dispatching Of Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Dynamic economic environment dispatch is a common multi-variable, strongly constrained, non-convex multi-objective optimization problem in power systems, and traditional algorithms are difficult to solve. Therefore, an improved IMOSSA-DE multi-objective optimization algorithm. First, initialize the population with a chaotic map to improve the quality of the initial solution, and increase the diversity of the population. In order to further strengthen the discovery and development ability of the discoverer, the sine and cosine strategy is introduced. Secondly, the traditional sparrow search algorithm is easy to fall into the local optimal solution, and the convergence performance is poor. The differential evolution strategy is integrated into it can enhance the global search ability and convergence performance of the population. In addition, non-dominated sorting, a new crowding degree distance calculation strategy and elite retention strategy are introduced to make the algorithm capable of solving multi-objective optimization problems. The optimal compromise scheduling scheme is obtained by fuzzy decision theory. Finally, the simulation results of the 10-machine power system show that the proposed algorithm can optimize the two conflicting goals of emission and cost at the same time, and obtains a better Pareto frontier than other algorithms, verifying the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Wind farm transmission line capacity increase based on dynamic matching of wind turbine power and line current-carrying characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Because the wind farm outgoing capacity setting calculation, and the standard wind speed is far lower in comparison to actual operating wind speed, resulting in a waste of the wind field's outgoing transmission capability. This study presents an approach for wind farm outgoing capability which considering the wind turbine's output features and the allowable carrying current of transmission lines. By analyzing the turbine's power curve and wind speed, the maximum carrying current of the transmission line and the wind farm's total power are dynamically matched under different wind speeds. For the wind farm in operation, the maximum outgoing capacity is calculated, while for the wind farm in design, the proposed method could reduce the cross-sectional area of the conductor used. The case study proved that, the suggested approach successfully raises the wind farm's outgoing ability while also enhancing its operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on The Low-voltage Governance and Evaluation Method for New Distribution System Based on the Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the promotion of distribution generation, microgrid and renewable generation, the structure and control method of distribution systems are experiencing an evolution process. The new distribution system faces the risk of low-voltage operation, due to the random output of distribution generations, the nonlinear characteristics of control systems, and the diversity of power electronic devices. One of the significant aspects of the distribution systems is the low-voltage governance and evaluation. A low-voltage governance and evaluation framework and technical scheme based on the digital twin technology have been proposed. A low-voltage governance model of the new generation distribution system is established based on second-order particle swarm optimization. The grey comprehensive evaluation is used to evaluate the low-voltage governance model. The optimal scheme is selected based on simulation results from a digital twin platform. The proposed framework and methods were implemented based on the CloudPSS platform and a modified IEEE-33 system was used as a test case. The results indicate the optimal scheme can solve the low voltage problem and improve the comprehensive performance of the system effectively.

articleTitle: Optimal scheduling of wind power system considering electric vehicle demand response
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: After the large-scale grid connection of wind energy, the crest cutting down space of the traditional power supply is inadequate, leading to the consumption of wind energy. However, the load capacity of electric vehicles is adjustable and can absorb a certain amount of wind. Therefore, this paper comes up with an optimal scheduling mechanism of wind power system considering the demand response of electric vehicles. Firstly, found on the response ability of electric vehicle load, the optimization model of electric vehicle participating in crest cutting down with the minimum system operation cost is established; Secondly, NSGA - II algorithm is used to solve the model and obtain the Pareto optimal solution set, so as to obtain the decision-making method of electric vehicle participating in wind power consumption;The simulation results show that this method is more effective than the traditional method and provides technical support for the adjustable load involved in wind power consumption.

articleTitle: An LSTM Neural Network-Based Fault Line Detection System Using CloudPSS-XStudio
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper designs a fault line detection system deployed on a digital twin application platform, CloudPSS-XStudio. which can easily deploy distributed neural network models on web software to meet the requirement of application platform engineering landing. First, original multi-source fault record data or simulation data is organized and stored in the CloudPSS data platform as a basic training database. Then, the proposed LSTM neural network-based fault line detection kernel is created and integrated into CloudPSS FuncStudio. Finally, a web-based application is built on AppStudio, which integrates the original data and analysis kernel to provide an online fault line detection service. Test results demonstrate the effectiveness of the designed platform. The performance is tested using benchmark test data with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Online Frequency Response Analysis of Multi-energy System Based on CloudPSS Real-time Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of fluctuating power sources such as wind power and photovoltaic, multienergy systems have the risk of high and low frequency oscillations, and there is an urgent need to construct a wide-band response analysis tool for multi-energy systems. In this paper, a method for rapidly constructing electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulation models of multi-energy systems is first proposed. Then, a real-time simulation platform based on CloudPSS is built to realize the hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) simulation of a large-scale multi-energy system. In addition, an online frequency response analysis platform is constructed and stability analysis of the large-scale multi-energy system is performed. The results show that the system has the risk of oscillation near the frequency of 986 Hz, and the control strategy needs to be further adjusted to improve the stability of the system. The constructed platform can also be applied to the stability analysis study of other large-scale complex systems.

articleTitle: Test and analysis of renewable-energy active frequency support capability of East China Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The proportion of renewable energy units in East China Power Grid increases year by year, and the renewable energy units without modification generally do not have the primary Frequency Modulation (FM) capability. Although the modification of renewable energy units in East China Power Grid have been started and some of them have frequency support capability, the actual frequency response capability in the regional power grid is still uncertain. Consequently, the State Grid East China sets up the plan in east China power grid to test the renewable-energy active frequency support ability.
