The test includes wind power, photovoltaic (PV), energy storage, wind storage and thermal storage, 5 types of frequency modulation unit combinations. The test results show that the modified renewable energy unit generally has a good ability of fast frequency modulation, and the error between test and simulation results is small. This test verifies that the coordinated combination of multiform FM resources with renewable energy as the main body is beneficial to the construction of east China Power grid to actively support the primary FM system, which provides valuable practical experience for the subsequent primary FM modification of renewable energy units, and has strong promotion and application value for East China and surrounding areas.

articleTitle: Stochastic Vulnerability Analysis methodology for Power Transmission Network Considering Wind Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a power network vulnerability analysis method based on topological approach considering of uncertainties from high-penetrated wind generations. In order to assess the influence of the impact of wind generation owing to its variable wind speed etc., the Quasi Monte Carlo based probabilistic load flow is adopted and performed. On the other hand, an extended stochastic topological vulnerability method involving Complex Network theory with probabilistic load flow is proposed. Corresponding metrics, namely stochastic electrical betweenness and stochastic net-ability are proposed respectively and applied to analyze the vulnerability of power network with wind generations. The case study of CIGRE medium voltage benchmark network is performed for illustration and evaluation. Furthermore, a cascading failures model considering the stochastic metrics is also developed to verify the effectiveness of proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Incipient Fault Detection of Power Distribution System based on Statistical Characteristics and Transformer Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: ncipient fault detection has become increasingly important in power distribution systems since higher requirements on power supply reliability were proposed. With more sensors and developments of intelligent algorithms, data-driven methods are recognized as a promising direction. In this paper, two main parts of this time series classification task are discussed: feature extraction of events and fault detection classifiers. For feature extraction module, statistical characteristics are comprehensively analyzed and chosen with hypothesis test and FDR multiple test. For fault detection classifiers, one of the most recent and powerful models, Transformer Network, is introduced with corresponding adjustments for the fault detection application. The inside attention mechanism and ability to build long-distance data dependency are the reasons for the high-level performance of Transformer. Experiments prove that the proposed framework is reliable in different conditions and has much better performance than related works, which provides an excellent reference for time-series classification tasks in the field of online monitoring and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Effect of Rotor Parameters on Leakage Coefficient of Spoke-Type PMSM
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Spoke-type permanent magnet synchronous machine provides good torque performance due to its magnetic congregate effect, but the magnetic flux leakage phenomenon is more serious than other interior permanent magnet synchronous machine (IPMSM). In this paper, the influence of changing the rotor structure on leakage coefficient of spoke-type PMSM is studied by establishing a finite element model. Moreover, magnetic flux density, back-EMF, torque and efficiency performance of spoke-type PMSM under no load and on load are also analyzed. The results show that increasing the aspect ratios of the permanent magnet, increasing the length of the flux barrier bridge, reducing its width, and improving the shape of rotor can effectively reduce the magnetic flux leakage, improve the torque and efficiency of spoke-type PMSM, and it provide a practical application of spoke-type PMSM.

articleTitle: A carbon emission calculation method based on the full life cycle of wind farms considering environmental impact
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In recent years, due to the excessive dependence of social and economic development on fossil energy, energy resources are increasingly exhausted. At the same time, a large number of carbon emissions have also led to the increasing greenhouse effect and the frequent occurrence of extreme weather. In view of the imprecision of the existing wind power carbon emission factors, this paper uses a full life cycle carbon emission calculation method of wind farms considering environmental impact, which analyzes the explicit and implicit carbon emissions caused by wind farms in various stages. In addition to the construction of the wind farm itself to the recovery cycle, we also need to consider the damage of the wind farm to the environment. Before and after the construction and withdrawal of wind farms, keep the regional environment unchanged, so as to comprehensively calculate the carbon footprint of wind farms in the ecosystem. According to the typical life cycle, total power generation and carbon emissions, the average carbon emission factor of wind power can be calculated, which can provide data support for the low-carbon transformation of power grids.

articleTitle: Analysis and prospect of comprehensive energy service policies and standards
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the shortage of traditional fossil energy, new energy sources such as solar energy and wind energy are used more and more frequently. The integrated energy system can break down the barriers between different forms of energy and integrate all kinds of energy for better utilization. Along with this, the comprehensive energy service based on energy service has gradually developed, but the corresponding standard system is still not perfect. This paper analyzes the relevant policies and standards in China, which can provide ideas for the subsequent formulation of the comprehensive energy service standard system.

articleTitle: Extraction method of renewable energy output interval based on CLIQUE clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the growth of the installed scale, the output fluctuation of renewable energy will gradually become one of the main factors affecting the safe and stable operation of the power grid. A fixed value is often used to describe the output of renewable energy, such as the simultaneous rate. However, it isn't easy to accurately describe the scenarios of renewable energy output in the new energy power system. To this end, this paper first investigates renewable energy's temporal and spatial characteristics: divides renewable energy by region and extracts historical data by season. Then, it summarizes the principle of CLIQUE clustering and adds the threshold of sparse density. Moreover, a two-dimensional renewable energy output data space is established. The paper proposes a method of extracting output interval by improved CLIQUE clustering and gives the clustering extraction process. The example verifies that this method can effectively describe renewable energy's uncertain output scenarios.

articleTitle: Risk assessment method of distribution CPS based on entropy weight fuzzy analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the risk of distribution cyber-physical system (CPS) caused by cyber-attack, a quantitative risk evaluation method of distribution CPS based on entropy weight fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (EW-FAHP) is proposed. Firstly, the risk of distribution CPS is described from three aspects: physical side, cyber side and the attribute of security vulnerability, and the quantitative method of distribution CPS risk index is proposed. In addition, fuzzy analytic hierarchy process (FAHP) is used to determine the relative weight of different indicators, and entropy weight method is combined to weaken the influence of subjective factors on indicator measurement. Then, based on the improved attack graph theory, the risk propagation model is established to realize the risk assessment of distribution CPS. Finally, based on IEC61850, the distribution substation model is constructed and simulated to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The Secure transmission method of distribution network messages based on SM3 algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, we analyze various digest algorithms applied to message encryption by taking our self-developed digest encryption algorithm SM3 as an example for the risk of power information leakage and malicious tampering in the process of data transmission of distribution network messages. The performance test of the algorithm is conducted using Visio Studio2017+Qt software development test interface, and the factors affecting the time consumption of power information data encryption are analyzed from the encryption time of different plaintext lengths. The test analysis shows that SM3 is already efficient in encrypting plaintexts with smaller data lengths, and the encryption time shows a linear increase as the file size increases, which is more secure, efficient and complete compared with other algorithms, and already meets the real-time nature of distribution network messages. Thus, it can be seen that the SM3 algorithm meets the transmission requirements of distribution network messages.

articleTitle: Data-driven robust planning for distribution network based on extreme scenarios
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the background of increasing uncertainty of distributed new energy access, a new capacity planning method for distribution network equipment is urgently needed. In this paper, the energy storage structure of implicit battery- ultra-capacitor combined distribution network is proposed to improve the distribution capacity by using complementary advantages. Secondly, a data-driven robust programming method for ellipsoidal sets is proposed. By considering the relationship between uncertain variables, uncertain sets can be described more accurately and the economy of the system can be improved. Then, CCG method based on extreme scenarios is adopted to make the model solution easier. Finally, the feasibility and economy of the model are verified by an example.

articleTitle: Infrared Image Recognition based on Hierarchical Attention Perceptron Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Infrared image recognition is one of the key technologies in intelligent substations. Compared with tradition image processing methods, deep-learning algorithms are preferred due to their stronger modelling power. However, few training samples impair the model performance, and brings Transformer network into consideration. Transformer network utilizes context information such as object relations in an effective way, but the computation complexity is not controlled for dense predictions on high-resolution pictures. To solve this problem, a Hierarchical Attention Perceptron (HAP) module which conducts window-based self-attention manipulations is introduced. This local self-attention strategy is further enhanced by shifted window partition configuration which connects neighboring windows to provide more information. By replacing the original backbone network and encoder with HAP module, the Transformer network has higher recognition accuracy and lower computation complexity. Experiments based on field data help find the best architecture, and prove the effectiveness of the proposed method with the comparison to mainstream models.

articleTitle: A Probabilistic Graph Model Based Operation Optimization Method During Disaster for a Multienergy System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper investigates methods for optimal operation of multi-energy systems to withstand extreme hazards under extreme disasters. Firstly, the paper establishes a toughness evaluation index for multi-energy systems from the definition of resilience, which comprehensively portrays the system's ability to face disasters by considering the frequency of damage to each device in the system, the magnitude of load loss caused by failure and the time element of the disaster. Subsequently, this paper gives a toughness assessment process for the system based on probabilistic graph model. The approach explores a distinctly different intuitive and effective approach to toughness assessment in terms of the infrastructure topology of the system. Finally, we propose a specific process for toughness enhancing of the system using the toughness assessment method, verifies the correctness of the proposed toughness assessment index and the effectiveness of the enhancing measures by testing results.

articleTitle: A method for identifying abnormal electricity consumption behavior based on user electricity consumption data mining
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the power grid structure, the power big data presents the characteristics of massive multi-source heterogeneity. Traditional data mining methods have been unable to cope with the changing data sources and structural forms. This paper proposes a method for identifying abnormal electricity consumption behavior based on user electricity consumption data mining. First, a feature mining model of electricity consumption behavior based on convolutional gated recurrent network is established, which comprehensively considers the spatial global characteristics and temporal local characteristics of user electricity consumption data, and improves the reliability and representativeness of feature mining. Then, a preprocessing method of user electricity consumption data based on K-means clustering is proposed, and the feature mining model is trained according to the clustering results of electricity consumption data, so as to improve the accuracy of the electricity consumption behavior feature mining model. Finally, the performance of the proposed method in the detection of abnormal power consumption behavior is evaluated and compared using the real user power consumption data set, which verifies the accuracy of the proposed method for abnormal power consumption identification.

articleTitle: Switch Cabinet Discharge Pattern Recognition Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power switch cabinet is composed of circuit breakers, measuring appliances and protective appliances, and it plays an important role in the acceptance and distribution of electricity. In the process of design and manufacture of power switch cabinets, it is inevitable that there will be some defects which are closely related to the generation of partial discharge. Therefore, it is essential to identify and warn partial discharge fault. In this paper, a fault identification algorithm based on UHF signal of partial discharge in switch cabinet is proposed. Firstly, partial discharge (PD) of switch cabinet was simulated in the laboratory, and typical insulation defects were set up. Pd signals were collected by ultrahigh frequency sensors, a three-dimensional PRPS pattern of different defect types were drawn, and characteristic parameters of PRPS images were extracted. Ensemble learning algorithms XGBoost and LightGBM were used to recognize pd PRPS images of three typical defects of switch cabinet, and the recognition accuracy of each algorithm was compared by five-fold cross-validation. The results show that the characteristic parameters extracted in this paper can well reflect the pd characteristics of different defects and realize the task of fault diagnosis and defect recognition.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation technology of distribution automation system based on open communication
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the leap forward development of modern communication and automation control technology, the theoretical connotation and application boundary of distribution automation technology are expanding, providing a platform for integrated regulation and real-time control of distribution big data and complex primary and secondary devices. Based on lEC 61850 standard, this paper introduces the concept of the standard and its typical application in distribution automation system in detail, and also studies the construction method of the main station and terminal simulation system of distribution automation supporting open communication. A hierarchical distributed architecture and object-oriented modeling technology are adopted to complete the semantic cutting of distribution devices and self-description of data objects, to realize accurate identification of devices, real-time communication and fast fault handling, and to provide an effective way to realize interoperability and seamless system integration of intelligent electronic devices from different manufacturers. At the same time, the panoramic display of power distribution automation is realized based on the unified interactive interface, which has strong display and training significance.

articleTitle: Mechanism and Suppression of DC Overvoltage of Static Var Generators
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: with high penetration of renewable energy, the grid strength has been decreasing. The static var generator (SVG) has been widely adopted as reactive power compensation device to provide fast reactive power and voltage support for the grid. However, SVG suffers from DC overvoltage during short circuit fault recovery and the possibility of detachment from the power grid. This paper established the detailed state space model of the grid-connecting SVG during short circuit fault recovery and analyzed the mechanism, key factors and suppression strategy of DC overvoltage. Simulation verified the analysis.

articleTitle: A Review of China's Low-carbon Energy Development Pathways
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The world is facing the arduous responsibility and significant challenge of energy conservation and emission reduction. China plays a significant and irreplaceable role in leading the global emissions reduction, and China's low-carbon energy transformation will bring substantial and universal benefits to China and the world. Some institutions and scholars have studied the low-carbon pathway of China's energy under multiple scenarios, such as carbon neutrality, 2°C target, and 1.5°C target. For this reason, this paper provides a review of China's low-carbon energy development pathways. The research methods, boundary conditions, and transformation pathways in 13 related reports/papers are compared in detail, which can provide an essential reference for the research of China's low-carbon development pathway.

articleTitle: A Single-Ended Protection Independent of Line Boundary for Flexible DC Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The current limiting inductance (CLI) is generally installed at exit of converter in the flexible DC distribution grid, which leads to the unfitness of the protections relying on the line boundary. This paper proposes a single-ended protection independent of line boundary for flexible DC distribution system. Firstly, the Peterson equivalent circuit is used to analyze the gradient of initial traveling wave in positive-sequence voltage (GITWPV) after internal and external faults. Secondly, the direction criterion based on the fault current and the fault identification criterion based on the GITWPV are constructed, and the corresponding protection method is formed. Finally, the topology of flexible three-terminal DC distribution grid is built by PSCAD, and extensive simulations are carried out. The simulation results verify that the proposed protection scheme can effectively identify the fault.

articleTitle: Online Emergency Control Strategies Considering Non-monotonic Variation of Scenario Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in the power supply composition, the minute fluctuation of renewable energy and contact section reaches millions of kilowatts. This makes the online pre-decision strategy based on “online anticipation calculation, real-time matching” risk of under-control. Firstly, based on EEAC theory, the mechanism of short-period scenario fluctuation affecting system stability is analyzed. And the transmission section limit interval is obtained based on the sensitivity of the generator to the contact section. Then the law of transmission section affecting stability control is divided into monotonic and non-monotonic cases, which can generate a short-period conservative scenario. Finally, the size of the difference between the strategy value under the conservative scenario and the current online strategy value is used as the basis for online strategy formulation. The online emergency control strategy under short-period non-monotonic variation of the response scenario characteristics is proposed on the basis of the formulation.

articleTitle: An Improved Characteristics Method Based on Step-Synthesis for Natural Gas Systems Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Simulation is an important way to study the coupling characteristics of integrated energy systems. As a common method of time domain simulation for integrated energy systems, the characteristics method still has the problems of too many intermediate variables and the need for intermediate nodes iterative calculation. To handle the problems, an improved characteristics method based on synthesis is proposed. Taking the natural gas system as an example, the proposed method can directly construct the numerical relationship of the state quantities at the beginning and end of the pipeline, and the relationship of the state quantities at the source and load nodes of the network, which improves the calculation efficiency while ensuring the simulation accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Breaker Circuit Resistance Test Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: High voltage circuit breaker is the key equipment of power safety, circuit resistance value of circuit breaker is an important parameter representing the running state of circuit breaker, representing the electrical performance quality of circuit breaker. At the same time, circuit resistance test belongs to the key experiment of power operation and maintenance, the purpose is to ensure that the electrical performance of the switch is stable, and the contact has no physical fault. Due to the small test resistance, the bridge method is commonly used for measurement, but the design of 100A stable voltage source has always been a difficult. Firstly, this paper introduces the principle of circuit resistance test of high voltage circuit breaker, discusses in detail the design scheme of stable current source of test equipment. The power supply is provided by using the super capacitor discharge principle, and the corresponding converter data are designed to stabilize the current. At the same time, the experiment proves that the proposed design idea can effectively provide 100A current and realize the circuit resistance test for high voltage circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Suppression and Reactive Power Accommodation of Electric Vehicle Charging Facilities
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: At present, more and more electric vehicle charging facilities are connected to the power grid. However, harmonic current is generated during the operation of electric vehicle charging facilities, which causes power quality problems in power grid. During the field measurement of the reactive power of charging facilities, it is found that the reactive power of some charging facilities is capacitive, and the reactive power compensation device is not put into use. In view of the above problems, a power quality improvement scheme based on passive filtering is proposed to suppress harmonics and absorb reactive power. The simulation model of charging pile and charging station is established in Simulink platform of Matlab, and the harmonic current characteristics are analyzed by simulation, which verifies the feasibility of power quality improvement scheme. This scheme provides a new idea for power quality optimization of charging facilities.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Control Model of Photovoltaic Plant Cluster Sending End Grid Considering Energy Storage Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In view of the problem that the grid connection of large-scale photovoltaic power generation makes the frequency regulation ability of the PV plant cluster transmission-end grid insufficient, this paper studies the frequency control model of the PV plant cluster transmission-end grid considering the coordination of battery storage. By establishing the transmission-end grid of PV plant cluster with battery storage, the regulation ability of PV plant cluster to cope with the frequency instability of PV plant cluster transmission-end grid under grid-connected condition is studied, and the transmission grid frequency control model of PV plant cluster is established. Finally, by building a simulation model, the feasibility of the frequency control model of the transmission-end grid with PV plant cluster is analyzed and verified.

articleTitle: Research on the Distributed Transaction of Weakly Centralized Massive Flexible Resources
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the integration of massive distributed resources into the grid, more and more traditional electricity consumers are becoming prosumers with dual identity of producer and consumer. It is of great significance to study the Peer to Peer (P2P) transaction between the prosumers. In this study, a weakly centralized prosumer P2P transaction model considering optimization of distribution network is established. Firstly, we constructed a prosumer P2P transaction model and used ADMM algorithm to solve it. The impact of optimization of distribution network on the model is then taken into consideration based on which we have the two-layer optimization model for prosumer P2P transaction considering the optimization of distribution network. Finally, the model is solved through iteration to minimize the transaction cost of prosumers and the operation cost of the distribution network, thus realizing the P2P transaction between multiple prosumers under the constraints of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Upstream and downstream Location of Voltage Sag Source Based on Sparrow Search Algorithm and RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the shortcomings of traditional voltage sag source localization methods such as low accuracy and insufficient utilization of sag characteristics, a prediction method based on Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) and Radial Basis Neural Network (RBF) was proposed. Firstly, the principles and criteria of several traditional voltage sag source localization methods are analyzed, and then a voltage sag source localization model based on SSA-RBF is established by combining multiple localization feature quantities. Finally, the proposed algorithm is verified based on the IEEE33 system. The simulation results show that the proposed method has a higher voltage sage location accuratcy rate than the existing single feature criterion method.

articleTitle: Voltage stability control method of sending-end power grid based on combination of photovoltaic and storage
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the impact of more and more distributed photovoltaics on the voltage stability of the system, the impact mechanism of distributed photovoltaics on the voltage stability of the distribution network is analyzed. Firstly, the voltage stability model of the distributed photovoltaic energy storage system is established, and on this basis, the influence characteristics of distributed energy storage on the voltage of the receiving end grid nodes are studied; then the coordination relationship model between photovoltaic and energy storage systems is established. Coordinate optimization of energy storage devices under different output conditions; by establishing the minimum objective function of system voltage fluctuation in the receiving end grid, taking the line power flow of the receiving end grid and the charging and discharging power of battery energy storage as constraints, the particle swarm algorithm is used. Quickly calculate the state of charge of the distributed energy storage, and judge the charging and discharging energy. Taking the actual operation data of a receiving-end power grid as an example, the simulation verification is carried out. The results show that the control method based on the coordination of distributed photovoltaic and energy storage proposed in this paper can effectively improve the voltage stability of the receiving-end power grid.

articleTitle: Data-driven Rolling Forecasting of Electric Vehicle Charging Load with Realtime Correction
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The number of household electric vehicles (EVs) is increasing rapidly, and the charging load of electric vehicles has become a huge power consumption of the power grid that cannot be ignored. Accurate forecasting of electric vehicle is an important guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the power grid. However, conventional forecasting method is difficult to reflect the real situation of the forecasting day, and resulting in poor forecasting accuracy. Therefore, this paper proposes a data-driven rolling forecasting method of electric vehicle charging load. In detail, this paper constructs a neural network model for EVs arrival time forecasting, and uses alternating direction multiplier method for model training to reduce the risk of falling into local optimization. On the basis, the model outputs are corrected in real time through mathematical methods according to the feedback information of the EVs which have arrived before the forecasting timepoint. The simulation results on the 2017 US National Household Travel Survey dataset show that the proposed method has better forecasting performance than the conventional method, and the utilize of feedback information is functional.

articleTitle: Reliability Analysis of DC Charging Pile Based on Fault Tree
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the electric vehicle industry, as one of its supporting facilities, DC charging piles have been more and more widely used. And the working status of DC charging piles is becoming more and more important. According to the reliability problems of DC charging piles, in this paper, we first put forward several indicators which can describe the reliability of DC charging piles, and then we explain the hardware system structure of DC charging piles, at the same time we analyse the failure rate of each modules by using the method of fault tree, and acquire the system availability by using the state space method, so the influence of failure rate on module raliability is analyzed comprehensively by using the two methods. Finally we put forward the corresponding improvement measures.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Shared Energy Storage in Multi-Region Integrated Energy System Based on Nash Negotiation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Shared energy storage and multi-zone integrated energy system have attracted much attention because of their advantages of significantly improving energy efficiency. The reform of electric power market makes the competition between multi-subjects increasingly fierce and the distributed characteristics more and more obvious. In this paper, shared energy storage and multi-region integrated energy system are regarded as different interest subjects, and the cooperative operation model of shared energy storage and multi-region integrated energy system is established based on asymmetric Nash negotiation game theory with the optimization goal of minimizing the total operating cost of each subject. An example is given to analyze the operating cost of each participant in the cooperation mode. Finally, it is verified that the proposed game model and distributed algorithm can give consideration to both individual and whole interests, which is more fair to each subject and ensures the stability of cooperative alliance.

articleTitle: Simulation and Verification of High Drop Terrain Cable Laying Scheme
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As an important tool of urban power transmission network, cables must ensure the safety of their operation. Cable laying in high drop terrain often results in uneven loading and over bending of cables. To solve the above problems, the traditional high drop cable laying scheme is proposed to be improved, and the traditional laying scheme and the optimized construction scheme are verified by finite element simulation. Using <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{3\mathrm{D}}$</tex> modeling software to model the cable, based on elastic-plastic mechanics and finite element theory, the traditional cable laying scheme with high drop is compared with the optimized construction scheme by simulation analysis, and the results are exported and analyzed mechanically. The results show that the traction force and side pressure of the cable under the traditional construction scheme are 2.353N/mm2 and 34865.212N, and the side pressure exceeds the standard. By improving the angle puller and conveyor, the side pressure and traction force of the cable are reduced to 1.173N/mm2 and 1799.592N, which meet the requirements of cable laying.

articleTitle: Cable Laying Technology in Trenchless Channel
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the rapid economic development, urban construction has become saturated and the usable space is becoming increasingly narrow. The construction of overhead transmission lines occupies a lot of land resources, and it is difficult to meet the needs of urban development. The high-voltage cable method has many advantages such as high line operation safety, small urban space occupation, and easy operation and maintenance. It is increasingly welcomed by power supply companies. This paper introduces the suitable conditions for the trenchless channel cable laying technology, and briefly describes the construction process, general scheme, equipment selection and impact on the facilities to be crossed, and this provides theoretical guidance for engineering practice of trenchless channel cable laying.

articleTitle: Analysis and Research on Model of Forecasting User Complaint Based on Hierarchical Labels
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper mainly expounds the research status of user complaints in power industry, as well as the analysis and research of current user complaints, and establishes a new model of predicting user complaints based on hierarchical labels. Firstly, the hierarchical label generation method is used to refine and subdivide various behaviors of power users, so as to realize the classification of complaint behavior labels for power users, and build a portrait of complaint behavior from power users by establishing a user label system; Then, based on the complaint behavior of power users, a joint graph convolution network is formed by integrating graph convolution, time-gated convolution and non-time gated convolution, and finally the prediction of user complaint behavior is realized. The joint graph convolution network is used to predict the complaint behavior of power users, so as to realize the rapid and active response to user complaints, thereby improve the satisfaction of power users.

articleTitle: Load frequency control of isolated microgrid based on soft actor-critic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Load variation and uncertainty of power output from distributed power sources such as wind power in microgrids have caused great difficulties for the stability of the whole microgrid. To address this problem, this paper uses deep reinforcement learning algorithm to design a controller to control the frequency of the isolated microgrid: firstly, a Load Frequency Control (LFC) model of the isolated microgrid was built containing wind power, energy storage, micro gas turbine, load and corresponding power increment constraints, secondly, Next, the LFC controller is designed using the flexible action evaluation algorithm, and the microgrid controller is generated through multiple learning training based on the reward function Finally, The SAC controller proposed in this paper can provide better frequency power quality for islanded microgrids when load step disturbances and load random disturbances occur in the system.

articleTitle: A probabilistic neural network-based fault detection method for flight control system
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The operational status fault detection of the flight control system plays a crucial role in the safe and smooth flight of the overall system. This paper adopts a data-driven approach to detect several typical faults of flight control system sensors, and proposes a new method for detecting sensor faults in flight control systems based on particle swarm algorithm optimised probabilistic neural networks. This paper combines the probabilistic neural network with the particle swarm optimisation algorithm, solving the problem of low accuracy of conventional algorithms for the detection of flight control system sensor faults and improving the fault diagnosis effect of the method. Simulation experiments prove that the diagnosis accuracy of the algorithm reaches 98.33%, which is much higher than other fault diagnosis algorithms, and proves the rationality of the proposed algorithm in this paper.

articleTitle: Single check method of relay protection fixed value based on OCR image recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of error-prone and low efficiency in the process of manually checking the actual parameters of the paper-based fixed value single distribution network, the OCR-based relay protection setting value checking method is used to realize the value acquisition and comparison of the fixed value list. check. This project has developed an automatic review of the issued and executed fixed value orders based on image recognition technology and artificial intelligence technology, and realized the automatic submission of the review results. First, perform preprocessing such as area segmentation, grayscale, binarization, corrosion expansion, etc. on the pictures of the fixed value sheets returned by dispatchers and field technicians; secondly, call Tesseract to segment each picture of the relay protection fixed value sheet Identify one by one; finally, compare with the real value, output the result when the correct rate reaches the expected value, otherwise re-synthesize the training library, and perform intensive training on the sample. The experimental results show that the recognition accuracy rate of relay protection fixed value single based on OCR is over 99.99%. The method provides a theoretical basis for single-checking of relay protection values, and improves the reliability and efficiency of power system relay protection management.

articleTitle: Dynamic prediction of multi-time scale load capacity of transmission lines based on Elman neural network online learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Dynamic forecasts of transmission line load capacity may be beneficial to the management of line fault repair and load scheduling schemes. Based on the changes in the operating environment, this approach can be used to forecast the multi-time scale load capacity of transmission lines. In order to achieve live learning, Elman neural networks are used to merge historical data of temperature, wind speed, and load. Dynamically forecasting the permitted load capacity of transmission lines at various operating periods is based on steady-state and transient heat capacity calculations. By comparing transmission line load with steady-state and transient load capacity, we suggest a method that takes advantage of the potential capacity of transmission lines.

articleTitle: Recent Progress in $\text{Li}_{2}\text{FeSiO}_{4}$ Cathode Materials
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Lithium-ion batteries (LIBs) possess high energy density, excellent safety performance, long service life, and no memory effect. These properties make them widely used in electric vehicles and consumer electronics. Cathode materials are critical factors in improving the performance of LIBs, in which <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Li}_{2}\text{FeSiO}_{4}$</tex> is the most potential cathode material due to its high theoretical ratio and good structural stability. However, <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Li}_{2}\text{FeSiO}_{4}$</tex> is a polyanionic orthosilicate consisting of tetrahedral polyanion structural units <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\text{XO}_{4})^{\mathrm{n}-}$</tex> covalently bonded to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{MO}_{\mathrm{x}}$</tex> polyhedral. This structure induces low electronic conductivity and poor <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Li}^{+}$</tex> diffusion coefficient, thereby greatly increasing the polarization during electrochemical reactions. In this mini-review, the structures and electrochemical mechanisms of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Li}_{2}\text{FeSiO}_{4}$</tex> were analyzed and the latest developments in the fields of doping, surface coating, and morphology design and tuning were reviewed. Novel perspectives and insights were extracted to further improve the electrochemical characteristics of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Li}_{2}\text{FeSiO}_{4}$</tex>.

articleTitle: A Review of Energy Transition Paths for Germany and Other Countries
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to summarize the experience of energy transition in several leading countries for renewable energy development, especially in Germany, by analyzing their energy transition paths. According to a series of energy policies and experience in Germany, energy transition needs to rely on policy mechanisms to increase the electricity production of renewable energy, including electricity price adjustment, and power system construction. In addition, France's “climate plan”, the shale gas revolution in the United States, and the development of hydrogen energy in Japan are all important driving forces for the country's energy transition.

articleTitle: Classification. integration mode, and typical application of energy storage in power grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Energy storage technology is widely used and has great potential for social demand, it is a key link in the energy internet. With the progress of battery energy storage industry, battery energy storage technology has gradually emerged alongside integrated and distributed applications. The integration methods of energy storage is the capacity size of the storage system and the transmission method of energy storage. Firstly, the characteristics and demonstration projects of energy storage integration methods are introduced in this paper. Then the planning strategies of energy storage integration methods in power systems are introduced based on their characteristics. Finally, the operation methods of different integration methods of energy storage are summarized from the perspective of power system economy and reliability.

articleTitle: Transient simulation and performance analysis for deep borehole heat exchanger coupled ground source heat pump system
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the northern China with cold climate, the deep borehole heat exchanger (DBHE) is widely developed in recent years, which is coupled with ground source heat pump system (GSHP) to supply geothermal energy for building heating. In this study, a new-type DBHE coupled GSHP system model was developed by combining the MATLAB and TRNSYS software. Considering the upper threshold of inlet temperature for the heat pump unit, the control logic between the plate heat exchanger (PHE) and the heat pump unit was designed. Taking space heating of a residential building as a scenario, the operating characteristic and energy performance of system were analyzed. The results show that the PHE operation time during a heating period gradually decreases from 651h to 212h over 10 years. The sudden decrease of PHE operation time will lead to the increase of seasonal performance factor of heat pump. Furthermore, the circulation temperature attenuation of DBHE decreases exponentially with the increase of heat extraction capacity. Moreover, the effects of dynamic and constant building heating load on the system operation and energy distribution relationship were explored. Compared with dynamic heating load, heat extraction capacity of PHE and heat pump under constant load is underestimated and overestimated during heating period, respectively. After 10 years of operation, the difference of heat extraction capacity of system reaches to 5.37 MWh. The results suggest that system performance prediction based on constant heat load has deviation from the real situation.

articleTitle: An Integrated Energy System Planning Based on Gaussian Mixture Model Clustering Using CloudPSS IESLab
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To achieve a transition to smart clean grid and low carbon energy system, integrated energy system (IES), which includes multi-energy synergy, has better renewable energy accommodation and provides high energy utilization efficiency, will play a significant role. However, the feasibility of IES planning is challenged by the intermittent nature of renewable generation, typical day scenarios and high computation requirements. This paper proposes a Gaussian mixture model clustering method for IES planning. The dimensionality of multi-energy data is reduced by the PCA method and automatically grouped into sets to generate typical scenarios based on the Gaussian mixture model. A numerical study of a real IES is implemented using this clustering method on the CloudPSS IESLab platform to investigate device selection and capacity options. The performance of the algorithm was evaluated.

articleTitle: Thermal Failure Research of Power Switch Cabinet Based on Temperature Cloud Mapping Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the process of power system operation, the overheating fault of power switch cabinet is the most common technical problem. This paper first analyzes the causes of the heating fault of the power switch cabinet, summarizes the physical relationship between the internal fault of the switch cabinet and the temperature of the cabinet, and establishes the relevant model of the internal heat flow of the switch cabinet. Through the temperature change feedback by the internal heat flow of the switch cabinet on the surface of the cabinet, the internal fault type of the switch cabinet can be effectively proved by the comparative analysis of the temperature cloud image. Therefore, the neural network algorithm is used to screen and analyze the thermal imaging cloud image of the switch cabinet surface, so as to judge the fault by comparison. This paper proves that the neural network algorithm combined with big data to compare and analyze the change of the surface cloud image of the switch cabinet can judge the fault type of the internal overheating fault of the switch cabinet, so as to realize the real-time monitoring of the power switch cabinet and improve the stability of the power system.

articleTitle: Evaluation method of line loss in station area based on feature selection and GRU network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As the terminal part of the power system, the station area is difficult to analyze due to the complex network structure and the large number of terminals. Therefore, a line loss evaluation method based on feature selection and GRU network is proposed. Firstly, the electrical characteristics are comprehensively analyzed based on the Spearman correlation coefficient method and the feature selection method of the XGBoost algorithm model, and the importance of each electrical characteristic to the line loss calculation and the optimal feature dimension for the line loss evaluation are obtained, and the optimal electrical feature is constructed. indicator system. Then, a network prediction model based on Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is established. The optimal electrical characteristic index system data is used as the input set of the prediction model, and RMSE, MSE and R2 are used as error evaluation indicators. Finally, actual station area data is used to verify the validity and accuracy of the suggested technique.

articleTitle: Modified Affine Strategy for Two-Stage Robust Optimization of Generation and Reserve with Correlated Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A robust optimal power system dispatching method based on modified affine strategy is proposed to cope with the generation reserve coordination problem considering wind power uncertainty. Firstly, focusing on power system with wind turbines, a two-stage power optimal dispatch model of generation and reserve is established. Secondly, considering the statistical information of wind power errors, the self-organizing mapping(SOM) neural network is applied to make the wind power data get clustered, and then multiple uncertainty sets of wind power output error are constructed. Then, on the basis of the robust optimization model with multiple uncertainty sets, a modified affine strategy method is proposed, and it is transformed into linear programming(LP) model by dual principle. A 6-bus system and IEEE 118-bus system are tested for case studies, then the modified affine strategy is compared with the conventional affine strategy. The results show that the modified affine strategy has higher solution efficiency and better economic benefits, improves the problem of conservative modeling of uncertainty sets, and verifies the effectiveness and advancement of the proposed strategy.

Index Terms: Root Mean Square Error Of Cross-validation

articleTitle: Research on vulnerable line identification based on PMU data and graph theory
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Cascaded faults in complex power grids are prone to large-scale blackouts, and vulnerable transmission lines in cascading failures play an important role. Finding out these lines in power grid is very important to prevent accidents. The determination indicators of previous research methods are single. In this paper, a comprehensive analysis is carried out from two aspects of system operation structure and line power flow carrying capacity, and a vulnerable line identification method based on PMU data and graph theory is proposed. Firstly, a topology map of the power system is constructed in combination with the characteristics of PMU data visualization in actual power grid. Secondly, combined with power exchange efficiency and energy fluctuation probability, vulnerable lines of the grid are screened, and the effectiveness of the index is tested. Finally, the simulation experiment is carried out in the IEEE 30-bus system. Simulation results show that the proposed method can accurately identify weak transmission lines of the power grid.

articleTitle: Collaborative optimization of energy management in integrated energy system group based on digital twin technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the dual pressure of environment and resources, the traditional energy model no longer meets the needs of today's social development, and the energy industry urgently needs transformation and upgrading. Combining integrated energy system groups and digital twin technology has become the primary means of assistance in the transformation process. Therefore, this paper first constructs the technical system framework suitable for the integrated energy system group using digital twin technology. Secondly, the collaborative optimization of energy management among different subjects in the integrated energy system group is carried out under this framework. Finally, the example results show that the technical framework based on digital twin technology can effectively guide the optimization of energy management among different subjects of the integrated energy system group.

articleTitle: Comparisons of Correlated Random Variables Decorrelation Methods in Probabilistic Power Flow Calculation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Large-scale renewable energy generations introduce complex correlated random input variables in power systems, which create challenges of uncertainty for operation and control. Probabilistic power flow (PPF) is a quantitative approach to analyzing power system uncertainty. To calculate PPF considering correlated random input variables, Orthogonal, Nataf, and Rosenblatt transformations are widely used for decorrelation. However, errors caused by the three transformation methods for different PPF calculation methods are still unclear. This paper investigates Orthogonal, Nataf, and Rosenblatt transformations in PPF. First, description methods of correlated random variables are reviewed, and the limitations of correlation coefficients are clarified. Second, the ideal conditions for using Orthogonal, Nataf., and Rosenblatt transformations are analyzed. The third is the discussion of PPF calculation implementations that consider correlated random input variables using different methods. The feasibility of the three transformation methods in different PPF methods is given. Finally, an IEEE 33 system integrated with real measured correlated wind powers is used to analyze PPF errors caused by the three transformation methods. The numerical simulation results show that the impacts on PPF error from decorrelating transformations are different in different PPF calculation methods. Recommendations for transformation methods in different PPF calculation methods are presented.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-agent Game Interaction of Regional Integrated Energy System Considering Complex Network of Demand Side
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The opening of the energy market makes the integrated energy system with single main body change to multi-main body mode, and the income of each main body is affected not only by its own but also by the decisions of other main body. Based on the integrated energy system structure of a system operator and multiple distributed energy suppliers and energy users, the paper establishes a multi-agent game interaction model of supply and demand in the system of day-trading, and establishes the agent optimization model to maximize their own benefits respectively. Based on the mayfly algorithm and optimization toolbox, the flow chart of game equilibrium solution is proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm has good convergence, and the multi-player interaction can realize the maximization of their respective benefits.

articleTitle: Research on Centralized Optimization Clearing Method for Interregional Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The paper presents an in-depth analysis of the clearing process of the interregional renewable energy spot market currently in operation and the trading path construction method, and explains the issues that need to be considered for the future development of this market. On this basis, a centralized and efficient interregional spot market clearing model is proposed, which makes full use of the current trading path construction method, considering the same optimization objective of price difference matching method and security constraints of interregional and regional power grids. With high scalability, this model can meet the requirements of power grid safe operation and further improve the enforceability of market clearing results. It can provide theoretic support for the development of interregional spot market and the effective coordination between cross regional and regional spot market in the future. A case study of a 5-region system is adopted to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Generative Adversarial Networks-based Distribution Network Operation Scenario Generation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in the distribution network, the uncertainty of renewable energy poses a challenge to the operation analysis and decision-making of distribution network. Scenario is an important tool to control and optimization of the power system under uncertainty. Therefore, how to generate scenarios efficiently and accurately is the focus of power system uncertainty analysis. In order to solve the above problems, this paper uses Generative Adversarial Nets to generate distribution network operation scenarios. By analyzing the operation scenario generation of distribution network and the principle of Generative Adversarial Nets, the structure and training method of Generative Adversarial Nets for time-series power flow data are proposed and verified in an example based on IEEE33 bus system. The results show that the designed network can learn the characteristics and distribution of operation scenarios of distribution network. This paper also proposes a general distribution network operation scenario generation platform, and gives a general method from scenario set construction to network training, testing and application.

articleTitle: Pre-disaster prevention strategies for coupled thermoelectric systems under extreme cold disasters
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Extreme natural disasters have occurred more frequently in recent years. Effective pre-disaster prevention strategies can significantly improve the ability of the thermoelectric coupling system to withstand extreme cold natural disasters, reduce the critical load loss, and improve the stability of the system's operating state. To improve the defense of the thermoelectric coupling system against extreme natural disasters, a two-stage pre-disaster optimization prevention strategy is proposed to reduce the risk of the electric coupling system being affected by a disaster. In the first stage, a thermoelectric unit output optimization adjustment model was established to increase the system load margin, and adapted to different fault scenarios to solve the unit output scheme to enhance the stability of the thermoelectric coupling system, and reduce the system stability caused by the rapid increase in load demand; In the second stage, a decision-making model for the optimal allocation of emergency resources was constructed. The preventive methods such as unit fuel allocation, mobile energy storage deployment, critical line inspection and reinforcement were coordinated to reduce the economic loss caused by equipment failure and load shutdown in the system. The simulation of the test thermoelectric coupling system is carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage optimization. Besides, the effect of the two-stage interaction is analyzed, which provides valuable reference information for the planning and decision-making of the power grid company.

articleTitle: Interaction between the Distribution System Operator and the Battery Storage Operator for Flexibility Procurement Services
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Fast penetration of the renewable energy sources and transition toward sustainable energy supply paradigm is currently an ongoing process. It comes with many environmental benefits, but it also creates many challenges. Distribution System Operators are forced to move on from the fit-and-forget approach and take more active role in operating distribution system to face problems such as bidirectional power flows, congestion and voltage limits violation. This article, taking into consideration that regulated entities cannot interfere with market activities, proposes interaction between distribution system operator and battery storage operator for flexibility procurement and investing in battery storage units at the most critical points in the network. Firstly, using AC OPF, most critical nodes are detected and then optimal energy and power capacity of the battery storage units are determined. Value of the flexibility service is determined by observing the profit difference from an optimal market participation strategy with and without network constraints.

articleTitle: Study on The Difference of Bodily Surface Field Intensity for Live Working Operators of UHVDC Transmission Line Considering Meteorological Factors
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: During live working on UHVDC lines, If the field intensity of a certain part exceeds some certain threshold, it will cause discomfort and even pose a threat to personal safety. As UHVDC transmission has a long span, the climatic environment of regions through which the UHVDC line passes is complex and changeable, the effect degree of meteorological factors varies greatly with different bodily parts. In order to explore the difference in the field intensity of different locations of operators with the changes in meteorological conditions, firstly, a simulation model is built on the basis of the actual situations of the UHVDC line, and its correctness is verified by comparing it with the measured data; secondly, a large-scale simulation of the bodily surface field intensity of live working operators under different atmospheric parameters is carried out, and the influence weight for each meteorological factor is distributed by the combination weighting; thirdly, the correlation between the bodily surface field intensity and meteorological factors is analyzed through the use of the grey relational analysis (GRA) to construct the evaluation matrix; finally, the intensity of the personnel electric field difference of each part of the live working operator is evaluated by combining the grey relational analysis with technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (TOPSIS). The result turns out that the field intensity of the feet and head is more susceptible to meteorological factors. Because the head is highly sensitive to field intensity and its protective barrier is relatively weak, it is necessary to focus on strengthening the field intensity monitoring and safety prevention and control of the operator's head. The research can provide a reference for constructing a complete safety protection system for live working operators.

Author Keywords: the difference in field intensity of each part

articleTitle: Research on multi-objective optimal scheduling strategy of new energy hydrogen production system
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A multi-objective optimal scheduling strategy based on improved radar graph model was proposed to solve the operation scheduling problem of new energy hydrogen production system in the scenario of grid-connected with no power injection. Firstly, a new energy hydrogen production system structure containing photovoltaic cells, wind power cells, lithium batteries, electrolytic cells, hydrogen storage tanks and electric and hydrogen loads is proposed. Secondly, considering real-time electricity price, parallel operation of multiple electrolytic cells and the utilization rate of new energy, three optimization objectives including economic benefit, wind and light abandoning rate and environmental cost were selected. The objective function was established through the improved radar diagram model with multiple objectives to meet the constraints of electricity and hydrogen load balance and unit operation constraints. Finally, the optimization solution is performed, and the results show that the proposed optimal scheduling strategy can reduce the start-stop of electrolytic cell and avoid power purchase during peak period. Compared with the single-objective optimization results, the comprehensive performance is the best, which verifies the correctness of the proposed multi-objective optimal scheduling strategy.

Author Keywords: Hydrogen production from new energy sources
