articleTitle: Reactive Voltage Control Method of Distribution Network Based on Multi-energy Coordination
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the coupling relationship between the pressure regulation of thermal and gas systems and the reactive power balance of power grid in electric-heat-gas multi-energy systems, a reactive power optimization model for multi-energy systems is proposed based on the reactive power demand characteristics in the energy transport process of thermo-gas systems. This paper studies the reactive power and output characteristics and their uncertainty of various power sources, and the reactive power demand characteristics of various energy transport processes, and establishes the reactive power balance and its uncertainty model of distribution network for a multi-energy system consisting of electricity, heat and gas with large-scale renewable energy supply. On this basis, the reactive power adjustable capacity quantization model based on the pressure adjustable limit parameters of heat, cold, hydrogen and gas energy medium transport pipeline and the corresponding reactive power demand capacity is studied, and the reactive power demand model under the coupling relationship between power grid and gas network is established to reduce voltage fluctuation. Establish the economic cost model of reactive power compensation device, reactive power supply and pump station; The uncertainty of reactive power balance and the constraint of source network load storage operation are further considered. In order to minimize the voltage fluctuation and the lowest cost, the reactive voltage control method of multi-time scale coordination and optimization is adopted to realize the stable reactive voltage control of distribution network through the reactive power optimization control of multi-energy regulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of Current Fluctuation Caused by Series Active Power Filter Based on Magnetic Flux Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The series active power filter based on magnetic flux compensation (MFC-APF) may lead to low-frequency oscillation of the amplitude of power grid current in the transient process. In the previous research, it has been found that the equivalent impedance of MFC-APF will show obvious negative damping characteristic in the low frequency range higher than the fundamental frequency. This paper analyzes that it may act together with the load impedance to make the system resonate. After simplifying the system reasonably, the transfer function model of system equivalent admittance including MFC-APF and the load is established. The analysis results of the model show that the amplitude of the equivalent admittance has a resonant peak near the fundamental frequency, resulting in the corresponding harmonic component of the current in the dynamic process, which is manifested as the low-frequency oscillation of the current amplitude. Finally, according to the impedance characteristics of MFC-APF, an improvement method is proposed, and effectiveness of the proposed model and method are verified by simulation in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Massive load control technology for a double-layer grid regulation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: It is important to make full use of the massive micro load to participate in grid regulation and control to ease the pressure of grid regulation and help grid carbon emission reduction. Firstly, the demand of the massive load control technology is analyzed, and the challenges faced by the massive load control technology are analyzed. Then the architecture of the massive load control technology for low carbon grid regulation is constructed. Secondly, based on the constructed technical architecture, the technical route of massive load control technology is proposed, which mainly includes a double-layer response model which can integrate with the response potential and response benefits. Finally, the research and development of fast response load control devices and systems are developed, an actual case is simulated to help the power grid to realize the double carbon target as soon as possible.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation Strategy for Distribution Grid with High Penetration Renewable Energy: a Novel Deep Reinforcement Learning Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A high proportion of renewable energy sources like wind and photovoltaic are connected to the grid as an important measure to alleviate the global energy crisis. However, the intermittency and uncertainty of wind and PV increase the voltage fluctuation of the distribution grid and threaten the safety of its operation. To operate the distribution grid economically and reliably, a novel deep reinforcement learning algorithm is proposed in this paper to optimize the operation of distribution grid. First, an optimization model is created with the target of minimizing the operation cost and maintaining distribution grid reliable operation, taking into account the constraints of each node in the grid. The optimization model is then reformulated as a Markov decision process and solved using the soft actor-critic (SAC) algorithm. The proposed method in this paper has excellent adaptability in the face of multi-objective optimization problems and can also perform online real-time scheduling. A comparative evaluation of the proposed approach is conducted between several benchmark approaches utilizing real-world data in order to demonstrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Effectiveness evaluation of representative transient reactive power location algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The direction of transient power is used by many manufacturers to determine the location of single-phase grounding fault, but the effectiveness and applicability of various representative algorithms have not been fully evaluated so far. This paper fully evaluates the effectiveness of the traditional transient reactive power direction method and the amplitude amplified transient reactive power direction method. Firstly, the segment location principles of the two algorithms are briefly analyzed theoretically. Then, the effectiveness of the two representative algorithms is evaluated and analyzed under the influence of fault resistance, fault initial phase angle, fault distance and noise. Finally, based on the simulation results, the applicable environment of the two algorithms is analyzed, which provides certain guidance for their practical application.

articleTitle: Parameter Optimization and SSR Mitigation of DFIG Considering PLL
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The phase-locked loop(PLL) is one of the important factors causing sub-synchronous resonance(SSR). The existing research on the mechanism analysis and mitigation measures of SSR do not fully consider its influence. This paper proposes a parameter optimization design strategy for DFIG combining orthogonal experiment method and particle swarm optimization. Firstly, a model of DFIG connected to weak grid by series compensation considering PLL is built. Then, the proportional and integral coefficients of the grid-side controller, rotor-side controller, and PLL are chosen as experiment factors. The SSR and dynamic characteristics of the grid-connected system are considered comprehensively by the compound weighting method. It reveals the sensitivity and influence trend of parameters on the system performance. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate that compared with the traditional orthogonal method, the proposed strategy can mitigate SSR more effectively while ensuring stronger anti-interference.

articleTitle: Research on Scenarios of Active Power Grid Security Accident Measurement Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the release of the national goal of “Carbon Peak and Carbon Neutrality”, a new power system with new energy as the main body is under construction. The power grid is an important carrier for connecting power sources and users. With the expansion of the scale of active devices represented by distributed generation and energy storage such as photovoltaic, wind power, etc, the degree of power grid activation continues to increase, and the factors that trigger grid security risks present new characteristics. Based on the analysis of active power grid security accidents, this paper extracts the risk factors and events of active power grid security accidents based on the accident cause theory, analyzes the key influencing factors of active power grid security risks, and establishes five factors including personnel, power grid, equipment, management, and environment, and two typical scenarios of optical storage hybrid microgrid and home photovoltaic grid connection are used for instance analysis.

articleTitle: A Novel SVPWM Control Strategy for Multiphase Dual Inverter for Electrical Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a zero-voltage vector redistribution control for the multiphase phase dual two-level inverter connected with a common source to suppress common mode voltage (CMV). CMV would generate bearing currents and shaft voltage. The zero-sequence current (ZSC) caused by zero sequence voltage (ZSV) would increase system losses and torque ripples. In such condition, the proposed strategy redistributes the zero voltage vectors according to the direction of ZSC. The zero-voltage vectors combinations are avoided to reduce the peak value of the CMV. Meanwhile, this strategy also reduces the switching times so that the switching losses are reduced. This proposed method is proved by simulation. The results proves that it can suppress both CMV and ZSV.

articleTitle: Research on Collaborative Black Start Technology Inside and Outside Urban Receiving Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Black start is the last line of defense for urban power grid to deal with large-scale blackouts. The rapidity and stability of its recovery are of great significance to urban security and stability. Aiming at the characteristics of less local power supply, high load proportion and large proportion of external power in urban power grid, this paper puts forward a collaborative black start method inside and outside the network. For the urban internal power grid, the local black start voltage security control strategy and zoning black start strategy are proposed; For the urban external power grid, the black start principle of external power grid is established, and then the collaborative black start mode inside and outside the network is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation comparison.

articleTitle: Generalized Composite Load Aggregation Considering Different Distributed PV Systems based on Improved K-means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the distribution network containing distributed PV systems based on the virtual synchronous generator control (VSG) strategy and power control (PQ) strategy, the generalized composite load aggregation method is studied in this paper. The improved k-means algorithm for the load aggregation is used in this paper whose initial cluster centers are determined based on the k-means++ algorithm and the cluster number is determined based on the Gap Statistic (GS) evaluation method. The distributed photovoltaic power generation systems are clustered and then in-cluster systems are aggregated by the improved k-means algorithm. The distribution network model and generalized composite load aggregation model with different control types of distributed photovoltaic power generation systems and composite load are built in PSCAD. In the end, the validity and effectiveness of the proposed generalized composite load aggregation method are verified.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Method for Transparent Regulation and Control of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the perception of the effectiveness of dispatchers' operations in the transparent regulation of power grids, a comprehensive evaluation method for transparent regulation of power grids based on order relation analysis method and grey correlation analysis is proposed. Firstly, a comprehensive evaluation system for power grid transparent regulation is constructed from the perspectives of safety, economy and complexity. Then, each indicator is weighted based on the order relation analysis method as an individual decision-making method, and a group is formed by combining the characteristic root method and the grey correlation degree. The decision preference weight is finally weighted to obtain the score of each scheme, which realizes the comprehensive evaluation of the transparent regulation process of multiple power grids and verifies the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Reliability Improvement Technology of On-load TapChanger of Large-capacity Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: As an important part of large-capacity converter transformer, on-load tap-changer gets a lot of attention in the aspect of reliability improvement technology. Existing pressure relief valve cannot work effectively after the failure of tap-changer, which will cause damage to the converter transformer body, fire and other faults. In this paper, a new pressure relief system is developed which combines pressure release valve and explosion-proof barrier board. Compared with existing products, the cumulative release flow in 60 ms of the proposed system is 2.6 times higher. It maximizes the release area with Y-type three-way interface, and reduces the internal pressure to half that with traditional pressure release valve. In addition, an explosion-proof isolation scheme is proposed to avoid on-load tap-changer faults affecting converter transformer body. The isolation arrangement reduces the maximum stress on oil tank to 35.9% that with original buried arrangement. Both simulation and experiments show that the proposed schemes are much better than existing products, which will effectively improve the reliability of on-load tap-changers.

articleTitle: Virtual RC Feedforward Control Strategy for Constant Power Load in Marine DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The paper proposes an active damping control strategy based on the virtual RC feedforward loop for the constant power load cascade system in marine DC microgrid. Firstly, the structure and parameters of the voltage feedforward loop were designed in detail, the transfer functions of the second-order low-pass filter and proportional gain controller were deduced. Then the system stability and audio attenuation rate after adopting the strategy were analyzed; Finally, the resonance suppression experiment and the load power mutation experiment were carried out on Matlab/Simulink respectively. The experimental results show that the strategy can well suppress the resonance phenomenon and ensure the stable operation of the cascade system.

articleTitle: Numerical Studies of the Influence of Geometrical Parameters of Heat Exchange Surfaces on the Efficiency of Heat Transfer Processes During the Flow Of Different Molecular Heat Carriers
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The paper considers the influence of geometrical parameters of heat exchange surfaces of heat accumulators on the efficiency of heat transfer processes during the flow of different molecular heat carriers. A mockup sample of a single matrix module was taken as an object of research. The influence of geometrical parameters of heat accumulator matrix fins, such as height, width and number of fins, was investigated. Body and single matrix modules were made of niobium alloy. The flowing by a different molecular fluid at different temperatures was investigated.

articleTitle: Dynamic Correlation Analysis with Industrial Electricity Consumption Volumes
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electricity consumption volume indicates objectively the operation status of the consumer entity. The dependency correlation is theoretically explorable by studying the relationship among electricity consumption curves. The analysis on industry electricity consumption correlation can be divided into static and dynamic, decided by whether temporal variation of the industrial structure and/or causality between consumption curves are considered. In this paper, dynamic methods are investigated as the static ones have been discussed in authors' earlier work. Methods applied in earlier papers to study the evolution of industrial electricity consumption correlation as well as their limitations are discussed. Then another dynamic analysis method based on wavelet theory is proposed. The two-step method is composed of (1) continuous wavelet transform to transfer the electricity consumption data into frequency domain and obtain the intrinsic period that reflects the operation condition of an industry; and (2) cross wavelet transform to obtain, from the wavelet frequency spectrum, the phase angle that can be interpreted as the time lag between the two industries. The application of the method is demonstrated with a case studying the spreading of the driving effect between manufacturing industries in prefectures of SD province. It is inferred that the response in electricity consumption to some stimulus could start at industry in the coastal area, then propagate to the capital circle, and finally arrive at less-developed inland prefectures.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Allocation Method of Wind-Solar-Thermal Integration Power Base
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The-wind-solar-thermal integration (WSTI) power base is an important technical mean to achieve carbon emission peak in China. A new optimal allocation model for the existing thermal power is given in this paper with the optimization target of maximum of new energy generation. In order not to increase the peak shaving pressure of power system, the additional regulation capacity of thermal power is used to bundle new energy resources, and the constraint of source-load similarity is intrduced for the first time. The source-load similarity is evaluated from two dimensions, namely fluctuation index and similarity index. The intelligent optimization algorithm is taken to solve the model. The proposed method can increase the electrcity production of new energy and efficiency of electric transmission line. Finally, an optimization model is built, and the simulation results prove the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on power fiber-to-the-home operation and maintenance technology based on fiber analysis method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: FTTH (fiber-to-the-home) is a transmission method of optical fiber communication. The power fiber-to-the-home is an important part of the overall construction of power fiber-optic cable communication network. The monitoring, management and fault location of power optical fiber resources are an important aspect of operation and maintenance work. This paper combines the principles of power optical fiber sensing, engineering and system construction characteristics and other factors to make the main monitoring methods. The dimensional platform provides an integration idea.

articleTitle: Identification of Partial Discharge Defects of Switchgear By Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Switchgear is the key equipment in the power system. The accurate and efficient identification of the type of discharge defects of switchgear is helpful to detect the fault in time and take measures to prevent the further aggravation of the fault. This paper simulates the partial discharge of 5 typical defects of switchgear through experiments, and puts forward a simple and easy-to-use identification method based on the statistical characteristics of partial discharge. 6 statistical characteristics are selected and calculated: maximum discharge amplitude, average discharge amplitude, total discharge amplitude, number of discharge, the ratio of discharge amplitude in positive and negative half cycle and average standard deviation of discharge amplitude. The results show that these characteristics can accurately characterize each typical defect of the switchgear. Based on the 6 statistical characteristics of partial discharge, the classification learners trained with different machine learning algorithms can accurately recognize 5 types pf typical defects of switchgear and the identification accuracy is very high. This method can provide some guidance for insulation fault diagnosis and early warning of switchgear equipment.

articleTitle: Layout And Suggestions Of Gas-fired Generation In Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to improve the consumption level of renewable energy and enhance the reliability of energy supply in Shandong, government will accelerate the development of gas-fired generator in the 14th five-year plan and the future. This paper studies the planning principles of gas units in Shandong, analyzes the income mode, and gives development suggestions in conclusion.

articleTitle: Research on Process Management and Verification of Relay Protection Setting Based on Data Dictionary
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the management process of relay protection setting documents in distribution network, there is no uniform standard for the name of setting items in the setting list, and there are differences when users fill in the setting list. Therefore, it is necessary to manually review the setting list, and the task is large and error prone. Therefore, this paper establishes a fixed-valued data dictionary management system, and uses natural language processing methods such as statistical learning and machine learning to apply to the fixed-valued data dictionary, and standardizes the naming and classification of fixed values with different names but the same direction, so as to carry out data identification, data numbering, data circulation, data classification and data storage. The data dictionary management module is used to conduct real-time intelligent verification and processing of the received setting list, which saves a lot of human resources and meets the requirements of the whole system. It improves the intelligent matching and efficient processing of relay protection custom list, and provides strong support for the management and verification of relay protection setting.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Electromagnetic Vibration in Large Capacity On-board Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: On-board transformer is one of the important components in vehicle-mounted mobile substations for power supply. The features of electromagnetic vibrations of on-board transformer are closely related to the mechanical condition monitoring and the mechanical structure optimization. In this paper, the electromagnetic vibration of the OSFP11-120000/230 type on-board transformer is calculated with a 3D model through the finite element method. The magnetic flux density and electromagnetic forces of winding and core of on-board transformer are analyzed by a field circuit finite coupling element. Through the direct electromagnetic-structure coupling method, the winding vibration and core vibration of on-board are calculated. It is that the distribution of magnetostrictive force is basically similar to the magnetic flux of on-board transformer. The axial vibrations of transformer winding reach the largest at 1/4 and 3/4 positions with a main frequency spectrum of 100Hz. The radial vibration of transformer winding reaches the largest at the 1/2 position and the whole vibration strength is smaller than those of axial vibration. The core vibrations in each part are different with relatively rich frequency spectrum components.

articleTitle: Automatic generation control performance evaluation method for thermal power units based on improved linear segmentation method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The participation of thermal power units in deep peak regulation is of great significance to the improvement of power grid consumption capacity, but the network-related performance decreases under deep peak regulation. Combined with the requirements for the automatic generation control performance of thermal power units, an automatic generation control performance evaluation method for thermal power units based on improved linear segmentation method is proposed. The method automatically divides the response, action and stability stages in the process of variable load, and conducts dynamic performance analysis on the variable load process. Compared with the existing evaluation methods, the automatic generation control performance evaluation method based on the improved linear segmentation method is less affected by noise, and the evaluation results are more accurate.

articleTitle: A Comparison Study among Various Techniques in the Application of Power System Anomaly Detection, Diagnostics and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Machine learning especially deep learning techniques play a significant role in anomaly detection, fault diagnostics and condition monitoring and are applied with an increasing trend in the power industry, while traditional methods such as signal analysis and statistical learning methods are still in use as well. This article discussed the applications of those algorithms and techniques in a comprehensive manner, introduced the relevance, differences and applications regarding those algorithms and techniques on the area of power system diagnostics.

articleTitle: A Single-Phase PWM Rectifier with Power Decoupling and Parameter Drift Compensation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Single-phase PWM rectifiers are known to suffer from second-order ripple power and voltage fluctuations in the DC link. In order to suppress the secondary voltage fluctuations in the DC link and to achieve unit power factor simultaneously, this paper investigates a power decoupled PWM rectifier with a DC-DC converter in the back stage for the matching of the load voltage. By analyzing the circuit, this paper investigates the selection criteria for the decoupling parameters and provides a method for the selection of the minimum DC link capacitance. To address the phenomenon of capacitance parameter drift in practical situations, a control method based on parameter compensation is proposed in this paper to achieve DC link voltage stability. Simulation results are presented to verify the effectiveness of the control method.

articleTitle: An Improved LVRT Control Strategy of VSCs for Support of Active Power
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Voltage source converters (VSCs) generally adopt the low-voltage ride through (LVRT) control strategies when short-circuit faults occur in the power system. As a kind of typical LVRT control method, the grid code requires VSCs to increase reactive power and to reduce active power to a low level. Although the grid code can keep the devices connected with the system, it cannot deal with the shortage and imbalance of the active power of the grid. In this paper, an improved LVRT control strategy based on the traditional LVRT control strategy is proposed, which can maintain the active power of the converter to a relatively high extent, thus ensuring the active power balance of the power system. The simulation results of MATLAB/Simulink demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Analysis of Control Strategies of an AC All Electric Propulsion System without Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the purpose of improving the power density of electric propulsion system and reduce vibration noises of the propulsion system, an AC all electric propulsion system was proposed, with generator connected with propulsion motor directly without converters and prime mover connected with generators connected directly without reduction gear box Theoretical mathematical model of this system was established. Constraints of static stability and variation traits of main electric indicators were analyzed. Three control strategies was proposed on considering improving the performance of the propulsion system, and operation traits of the system under each control strategy was analyzed. Validity and precision of mathematical model and theoretical analysis were verified by mathematical simulation.

articleTitle: Cross-provincial clean energy consumption in East China
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Four provinces and one city in East China are affected by their respective loads and resource endowments, and the level of clean energy development varies greatly from province to province, which is overall not enough to achieve the 3060 target, and the level of clean energy utilization needs to be improved. Considering the defects of long development cycle and large investment of clean energy represented by nuclear power and hydropower, it is necessary to actively improve the renewable energy mainly wind power and photovoltaic power generation. Due to the large intermittency and randomness of wind and photovoltaic energy and the influence of the operating boundary of controllable thermal power units in each province, there are currently restrictions on the consumption of clean energy in each province, and for the sake of system operation safety, the mandatory increase in the installed level of clean energy mainly wind and photovoltaic power generation will lead to an increase in the amount of abandoned wind and abandoned light. Therefore, in this paper, we investigate the boundary level of the installed wind and solar power units to improve the overall clean energy consumption capacity and reduce the operating cost of coal-fired units in East China by studying the cross-provincial clean energy consumption.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Method of Series Reactance of Shunt Capacitor Based on PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The determination of the total capacity of shunt capacitors and the configuration of series reactance parameters directly affect the economy of power system operation. A method to calculate the total compensation capacity of capacitor bank is presented, which is by calculating the reactive power loss of transmission line, transformer and the compensation capacity required to increase the power factor to the specified parameters. The optimal configuration model of series reactance based on particle swarm optimization (PSO) is established with the minimum total current distortion rate on the high voltage side as the optimization objective and the safe working current and safe working voltage of the capacitor as the constraints. The effectiveness of the optimization method is verified by comparing with the traditional reactance rate selection method.

articleTitle: An Approach for Identification of Broadband Oscillation in Power System Based on Hanning Window Double-spectrum-line Interpolation FFT
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The fast Fourier transform (FFT) is the main method of electrical signal analysis, but there are difficulties in performing non-synchronized sampling when FFT is applied to analyze broadband oscillation. In this paper, the broadband oscillation model of power system was established, and non-synchronous sampling problem was introduced. The sidelobe characteristic of Hanning window and the double-spectrum-line interpolation algorithm were both discussed, an approach for identification of broadband oscillation in power system based on Hanning window double-spectrum-line interpolation FFT was proposed, the applicable rectification formulas of the Hanning window double-spectrum-line interpolation was obtained by using polynomial curve fit function. The verification study showed that the algorithm proposed in this research was highly accurate when signals were sampled non-synchronously.

articleTitle: Influence of Different Design Parameters on the Shifted Load Behavious of Borehole Heat Exchanger Array System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To contribute to the goal of carbon neutralization, the borehole heat exchanger (BHE) system is widely applied to use geothermal energy for buliding cooling and heating. In practical application, there will be thermal interaction between BHEs,, which will lead to the phenomenon of shifted load. In this work, a comprehensive numerical model with 5 U-type BHEs has been established by OpenGeoSys coupled with TESPy to clarify the impact of multiple factors on the the shifted load bahavious of BHEs. The influence of different arrangements and interboreholes spacing on the shifted load bahavious of BHEs are studied. The results show that the heat load gradually moves from the center to the edge of the boreholes by analyzing the shifted load of the characteristic borehole heat exchanger. The maximum shifted load of the central characteristic borehole of the horizontal arrangement is much smaller than that of the square arrangement, and the proportion of the shifted thermal load(PSTL) range of the square arrangement is also the largest among the three arrangements, which indicates that the denser the arrangements, the greater the impact of shifted load on the BHE. After changing the inter-boreholes spacing of the square arrangement, for the central borehole, the maximum change of the shifted load rate at D = 3m is close to twice that at D = 6m, which can be seen that with the increase of the inter-borehole spacing, this shifted load phenomenon is weakened, which provides a reference for the design of BHEs in the future.

Author Keywords: proportion of the shifted thermal load

articleTitle: A Review of Image Recognition in Power Nameplate Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, a review of power nameplate image recognition is conducted from two perspectives. On the one hand, a summary is made as to the current status of research conducted on power nameplate image recognition through traditional computer vision methods. On the one hand, the deep learning methods of power nameplate image recognition are reviewed. Lastly, the future directions of research on power nameplate image recognition are indicated.

articleTitle: Investigating the effects of influencing factors on deep U-type borehole heat exchanger by using Taguchi method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, the Taguchi method is used to evaluate the influence of five influencing parameters on the heat extraction performance of deep U-type borehole heat exchanger. The five influencing parameters are the outer diameter of heat exchanger, geotechnical thermal conductivity, geothermal gradient, specific heat capacity of soil and flow rate. The level of each factor is set according to the actual problem, and the significance of the influence of parameters is given by the method of signal-to-noise ratio. articleTitle: Comparative Study of the Impact of SVC on the SSR in DFIG-based Wind Farm Systems Under Different Series Compensation Levels
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Sub-synchronous resonance (SSR) would be triggered in a doubly-fed induction generator-based wind farm system which is connected to series compensation lines radially. Meanwhile, static var compensator (SVC) is usually employed in the wind farm system, allowing for controlling the voltage at the point of common coupling (PCC). In this regard, it is necessary to analyze the impact of SVC on the SSR in wind farm systems. In this paper, a simulation model of a wind farm system with SVCs is firstly established in PSCAD/EMTDC and SSR is simulated under different compensation levels. Then, an impedance-based explicit model of the wind farm system with SVC is proposed to cross-validate the results obtained by the simulation model. Test results are shown that the parallel operation of SVC can improve the characteristics of SSR in the wind farm system under different compensation levels.

articleTitle: Research on Identification Model of Weak Area of New Energy Grid Considering Operation Risk and Transient Stability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In view of the weak area identification problem which has great influence on the transient stability of power grid after power grid failure, this paper established a weak area identification model of new energy grid considering operation risk and transient stability constraints. By deducing the identification parameters of root fault and weak area of new energy grid, and putting forward the weakness index of new energy grid line, it is used to identify root fault equipment and weak area in new energy grid. The IEEE-39 node test system is selected as a case to analyze. The results show that the proposed weak region identification method considering transient security and stability constraints can effectively identify the possible weak regions in new energy grid.

articleTitle: Optimization of Planar Helical Microphone Array Based on Rotation Angle Difference Randomization Strategy of Adjacent Array Elements
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, a microphone array for the localization of abnormal noise class defects in dry-type transformers is optimized. Near-field spherical waves are used as the dry transformer acoustic signal model. The array aperture, the number of array elements, the number of spiral arms, the imaging area size, the source frequency, and the distance from the source to the array plane are the constraints. An optimization strategy of randomizing the angular difference of adjacent array elements on the spiral arm is used to construct the solution set. The optimization objectives are the weighted sum of the half-beam width and the maximum sidelobe level is minimized. The solution is performed using the bacterial foraging algorithm. A 64-element array with an aperture of 0.5 m is used as a validation example. The optimized array achieves the best performance at an arm number of 8. The variation pattern of array performance with source frequency and source distance is visually portrayed using a heat map. Compared with the Unerbrink array, which is also designed with an 8-arm spiral structure, the array designed in this paper has a wider detection frequency range and a larger detection range.

articleTitle: Research on broken line fault location method based on innovation graph
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the face of many new challenges of power security and user requirements for power supply quality, the continuous and reliable operation of power grid and the development of power security technology have received more attention, among which fault location, isolation and restoration of power supply are key technologies. Based on the advantages of innovation graph in identifying abnormal events such as bad data and topology errors, this paper analyzes the amplitude characteristics of current innovation and voltage innovation when the disconnection fault occurs, and proposes a new start criterion and fault phase selection method. Then, the current innovation excluding bad data is taken as the data basis, and the method of locating the broken line fault line based on the modified prediction ratio is proposed. The broken line and fault phase are located according to the prediction ratio. The example verifies the feasibility and correctness of the fault location method based on innovation graph.

articleTitle: Current-limiting and Short-circuit Protection for Shipboard AC Smart Power Distribution Module in Centralized Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of centralized power system in all-electric ships, stability and reliability has become a great challenge. Nonlinear loads such as uncontrolled rectifier bridge with large output capacitive filter switched on at the peak of the sinusoidal wave may result in instantaneous current spike and large voltage drop, leading to misoperation or power loss of other sensitive loads. Moreover, when short-circuit appears, there will be even larger instantaneous current, which may completely destroy the entire power distribution system. Therefore, AC power distribution module equipped with automatic current-limiting function and short-circuit protection has become a necessity. In this paper, a single-phase 220VAC smart power distribution module is proposed with its control strategies detailedly illustrated and analyzed, to distinguish different load type, automatically limiting large surge current and cutting off short-circuit branch timely. This technique greatly secures reliable operation of the power distribution system. Experiments carried out on a single-phase 220VAC/5kVA prototype validate its feasibility and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Unsupervised Contrastive Learning for Power Equipment Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Power equipment image recognition is conductive to improving the inspection efficiency and quality in intelligent substations. However, few available labelled data and complex background largely increase the difficulty of identification. In this paper, an unsupervised learning algorithm based on contrastive loss and Transformer network is proposed to solve the small-sample learning problem. Contrastive loss is to build a dictionary where keys and queries are image patches of equipment. To enlarge the size of dictionary, the model implements it as a queue of samples and uses momentum updating strategy to ensure the encoder of key to be consistent. On top of that, Transformer network which is good at capturing context information in images is introduced and combined with contrastive loss. The key and query are those from encoder and decoder of Transformer network. Experimental results show that the proposed method realizes the unsupervised learning of power equipment image recognition task and outperforms other recent unsupervised strategies.

articleTitle: Resilience Evaluation of Grid Operation Mode for the New Power System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the context of new power system, the “source changing with load” mode commonly found in traditional power systems is transiting towards the “source-grid-load interaction” mode. When the power supply and the load in the power grid are uncertain, it is difficult to perform optimization of grid structure configuration. Therefore, the performance metrics of the grid's operation mode and its resiliency need to be re-evaluated. Grid resiliency refers to the capability of the grid to respond rapidly and flexibly to disruptions. This paper introduces the basic concept of the resilient power grid and elaborates five indexes to assess the resilience of power grids. With an example grid structure model obtained from a provincial power grid, the five indexes are calculated to obtain the evaluation results of the resilience of the specified grid. A conclusion is drawn in the end.

articleTitle: Vacuum Interrupter Design for On-Load Tap-Changer of Large-capacity Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Vacuum interrupter is the key component of on-load tap-changer of large-capacity converter transformer. Existing products are not reliable enough after long mechanical life and electrical life. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a new design scheme based on a systematic analysis of technical requirements and difficulties. In this new design, contact material selection, arc shielding system arrangement, design margin of corrugated tube, weld structure, static end design, and guide rod diameter are all discussed. In addition, electric field calculation is adopted in structure design, and contact design as well as shielding system are compared between the proposed schemes and existing products. Experimental tests include material selection and seven important projects: closing force, reaction force, vacuum degree, short time power frequency withstanding voltage, lightning impulse withstanding voltage, environmental test and X-ray test. The results show that the proposed schemes are much better than existing products and qualified in all tests.

articleTitle: Research on Improvement Measures of Lightning Resistance Level of Transmission Tower
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: It is of great significance to improve the lightning resistance level of transmission tower and reduce the trip rate of tower for improving the safe and stable operation of power system. In this paper, the lightning resistance performance of tower is studied by taking the 66kV four-circuit and six-circuit transmission line with the same tower as an example. First, choose the tower type with high lightning resistance level and good economy. Secondly, through the theoretical calculation and practical experience of the transmission line when lightning strikes the tower, provide the lightning resistance level, lightning trip rate and other key data of the line, and evaluate the lightning resistance level according to the relevant national standards. Finally, propose the improvement measures to improve the lightning resistance level of tower, which can provide a reliable basis for the study of lightning resistance level of tower of overhead transmission line with double circuit or more.

articleTitle: Joint Estimation of State of Charge and State of Health and Fault Early Warning for Energy Storage Power Station based on Double Unscented Kalman Filter Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The state of charge (SOC) and state of health (SOH) of a lithium battery are important core parameters for the battery management system. During operation of an energy storage power station, the on-line SOC and SOH of each single cell in the battery energy storage system must be estimated accurately to allow these parameters to play roles in providing early warning of energy storage power station failure, avoiding overcharging or discharging of the battery, and enabling timely battery replacement following aging. This ensures safe and stable operation of the energy storage power station. Therefore, to improve the estimation accuracy of the lithium battery SOC and SOH, based on a second-order resistor-capacitor equivalent circuit model, the double unscented Kalman filter algorithm is used to estimate the lithium battery SOC and SOH jointly online. The accuracy and stability of the proposed method are verified under DST conditions.

articleTitle: Research on carbon footprint tracking technology of power grid based on virtual power flow and loss sharing
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a carbon footprint tracking algorithm for the grid based on virtual flow and loss apportionment. Firstly, the actual physical flow on each line is decomposed into the virtual tidal power subordinate to each power source; secondly, the circuit balance theory is used to analyze the proportional relationship between the node outflow line and inflow line power, and the node power balance equation is used to construct a set of unknown quantity equations for the virtual flow of the circuit for flow decomposition. On this basis, the results of the tidal current dissection are used to apportion the responsibility of network loss. Finally, the tidal current-carbon flow mapping relationship is solved using the differentiated carbon emission factors of each power source to trace the sources of carbon emissions generated by the grid load and network losses. The algorithms and effects are verified for the actual grid, and the carbon flow paths and carbon emission dynamics of the source network load can be accurately solved.

articleTitle: Low-voltage Regulation Method Based on Flexible DC Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: According to the low-voltage characteristics of the distribution network and the flexible DC transmission idea of the main network, a set of multi-terminal DC low-voltage regulator (MVR) is designed. Using AC-DC transformation, focus on the distribution area with long power supply radius and thin wire diameter in the distribution network, and solve the problem of difficult power supply for the end users of the distribution area in the early stage of the completion of the network reform project. At the same time, according to simulation calculations, the use of this device can effectively reduce distribution area loss and improve the transmission capacity of the distribution area.

articleTitle: Ill-conditioned Problem of Fault Location Equations for Three-Terminal Lines in Distribution Network by $\mu\mathbf{ MPMU}$
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Three terminal line is a typical structure in distribution network, and its fault location has been the focus because of the large scale distributed generation integration. Recently, a parameter-free fault location method based on line voltage was proposed, which overcomes the problem that line parameters are unknown and only two line voltages can be measured in distribution network of China. Although it is more practical than previous methods, the RTDS test shows that the location equations of this method have ill-conditioned problems, that is, tiny measurement error causes too large deviation in the result. To study this problem, the ill-conditioned problem of the location equations is analyzed by condition number at first. Then the condition number of the location equations is calculated by simulation, and it is verified that the location results will produce a large error in the condition of small error of PSCAD simulation data and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathbf{MPMU}$</tex> measurement data from RTDS device.

articleTitle: Research on Remote Meterage and Monitoring Method for AC Charging Pile of Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: According to the traditional full-scale on-site periodic verification mode for AC charging piles, the verification amount of AC charging piles is large, and the required manpower, time, and equipment investment costs are high, and on-site calibration is easily affected by environmental and weather factors, and the traditional on-site calibration is more time-consuming and laborious. In view of the above problems, a remote meterage and monitoring method of AC charging pile meterage data based on total-branch meter method is proposed in this paper. The basic energy meterage error of AC charging pile is obtained by the remote data processing, statistics, algorithm calculation and analysis. Compared with the on-site meterage results of the AC charging pile standard equipment, the results show that through the tests of multiple charging piles and multiple time periods, the electric energy error of the charging pile calculated from the remote meterage and monitoring data of the total-branch meter method is basically consistent with the size and trend of the electric energy error data measured by the standard device of the charging pile. This method provides data support for the feasibility of the application of big data remote meterage in the meterage and calibration of charging pile, provides direction for innovating the meterage and monitoring forms and methods of charging facilities.

articleTitle: A Log-based Operation Event Mode Mining Method and Application for Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The intelligent process of monitoring power grid is heavily needed as expansion of modern cities and development of smart grid. At present, most of the dispatching control systems of urban power grids are manually completed by dispatchers for monitoring, early warning and post-processing of power grid operation accidents. The degree of informatization and intelligence has great room for improvement. In order to solve the above problems, this paper illustrates a log-based operation event mode mining method with Petri Net model to monitor status of power grid. By analyzing the demand analysis of the dispatching system, the single-substation discriminator and global power grid operation detection double-level model structure is designed. The result test on the real data set shows that the method can prompt possible accidents or abnormal states and help save human resources.

articleTitle: Frequency Domain Fitting of Grid-connected Inverter's Impedance
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to solve the stability problem caused by the interaction between the inverter side and the grid side when a large number of distributed grid-connected inverters are connected to the public grid, the frequency domain fitting method is introduced into the analysis of new power system in this paper. In this paper, the frequency domain fitting method of transfer function is introduced firstly, and then the process of generating system equations required by the method when the system contains control and nonlinear parts is demonstrated by taking a single grid-connected inverter closed-loop system as an example. In this method, the transfer function of the grid-connected inverter under any given input and output can be obtained only by the topology structure information and control strategy information of the grid-connected inverter. The frequency domain fitting method effectively avoids the tedious problem of deriving the equivalent output impedance manually for the stability analysis of power electronic converters under different topologies and control strategies. This method can fit the topology and control strategy of the new grid-connected inverter effectively in frequency domain.

articleTitle: Research on Effects of Parasitic Parameters on SiC three-level power module Parallel Application
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the parallel application of SiC three-level power modules, the traditional parallel current analysis method for IGBT devices cannot accurately analysis the current distribution in SiC three-level power modules. In this paper, the method of current analysis and dynamic junction temperature calculation of SiC devices considering the influence of parasitic parameters is proposed. By establishing the equivalent circuit model of a 3.3kV full SiC three-level power module considering the parasitic parameters, the current distribution of the power module is analyzed theoretically. Finally, the correctness of the presented analysis and calculation method is verified by the experiment results.

articleTitle: Research on distributed intelligent predictive control for flexible load tracking of thermal power units
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to stabilize the fluctuation of renewable energy power generation in the power grid, thermal power units often need large-scale variable load operation. To reduce parameters fluctuations and guarantee operation safety, this paper proposed a distributed intelligent predictive control strategy for flexible variable load operation of thermal power units. The innovation of the proposed distributed intelligent control strategy mainly includes the following two aspects. On one hand, aiming at describing the nonlinear dynamic characteristics of thermal power units in the process of variable load operation, the strategy constructs a nonlinear predictive control model through data-driven machine learning method. On the other hand, the computational complexity of a nonlinear controller is reduced by using a distributed method in this strategy. It divides the thermal power unit into two parallel computing sub-control systems, which are boiler subsystem and steam turbine subsystem, respectively. Moreover, it realizes the information interaction between the two sub-control systems and achieves the global optimization decision of the thermal power unit based on Nash equilibrium game method. The simulation results show that the proposed control method in this paper can not only ensure the tracking accuracy of large-scale variable load operation, but also reduce the fluctuations of operation parameters and guarantee the safe, economic and stable operation of thermal power units.

articleTitle: Research on the Evolution of Industrial Structure and Power Load in Southern Region under the Goal of Carbon Neutralization
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This study takes the southern region as the research object, and studies changes of industrial structure and electricity loads in 2060 under carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. Three scenarios are established to study changes in industrial structure and electricity load under the constraints of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality targets.

articleTitle: Diagnosis method of demagnetization fault in interior permanent magnet machine rotor
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Permanent magnet machine has attracted more and more attention because of its advantages such as high torque, high efficiency, small size and simple structure, but the demagnetization fault of rotor has seriously affected its operation reliability. To solve this problem, a detection coil is placed on the stator side of the machine to monitor the permanent magnet magnetic field, and to diagnose the position and the degree of demagnetization fault in rotor. Firstly, the mathematical model of the no-load fundamental induced electromotive force (EMF) in the detection coil of the interior permanent magnet machine with any number of poles and slots is derived. Then, combining with wavelet transform, a fault diagnosis method based on induced EMF is proposed. Finally, the finite element method is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Results show that this method can well diagnose the location and the degree of the demagnetization fault.

articleTitle: Analysis of Design Parameters Optimization of an AC All Electric Propulsion System without Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: For the novel AC all electric propulsion system without converters the magnetic and electric circuits systems of generators and propulsion motors were strongly coupled, and performances of them had tight interactions, that is the system was of high order. In order to avoid that electrical indicators of the system would not exceed limitation in all operation conditions, mandatory constraints were proposed, under the consideration of stability, field current limitation and stator current limitation. Principles of design parameters matching of the two machines were analyzed and achieved theoretically and mathematically. Furthermore, on the basis of previous studies on control strategies, methods of design parameters optimization were proposed respectively and comprehensively, with the purpose of applying and switching the proposed control strategies flexibly and optionally.

articleTitle: A Bidirectional Semi-Modular Isolated Matrix-Type AC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a bidirectional semi-modular isolated matrix-type AC/DC converter. The three-phase AC side of the converter adopts a semi-modular design, and each module adopts a line-frequency matrix-type rectifier and an inverter converting the single-phase AC power to a high-frequency alternating voltage. Three high-frequency transformers' primary windings connect to the three inverters respectively, and the secondary windings connect in series and then feed into the output rectifier. The three modules of the input stage of the converter are connected in a star shape. To eliminate the zero-sequence voltage pulsation caused by the unbalanced midpoint potential of the input side, a neutral point potential balance control strategy is proposed. The simulation results show that symmetry and sinusoidal input currents, balances neutral point potential and bidirectional power flow are achieved. The correctness and feasibility of the presented methods are verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Research and construction of Digital intelligence power purchase management service platform based on “data pool and logical pool”
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to adapt to the current situation of the rapid development of new energy in northern Hebei, promote the digital transformation of power purchase business, and improve the operation benefit analysis ability and power purchase decision-making ability of power grid enterprises, this paper adopts the mode of “data pool + logic pool” and applies digital and intelligent technical means to build a digital intelligent power purchase management service platform, aggregate multiple system data, structure the power purchase settlement relationship, and establish a time-sharing comprehensive prediction model of power purchase. So as to realize the online management of the whole process of power purchase business and improve the efficiency of power purchase management.

articleTitle: Multi-timescale optimal scheduling of integrated energies considering supply and demand interactions
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to cope with the current challenges brought by the volatility of renewable energy and the random entry of large-scale electric vehicles into the grid, how to realize the interaction between the supply and demand sides becomes an urgent problem to be solved at present. First, a price-based response strategy based on time-of-use tariffs and an incentive-based response strategy that takes into account response uncertainty are proposed, making full use of the identity of EV virtual energy storage, which together constitute an aggregated EV dispatch strategy that accounts for demand response. Secondly, to address the inherent prediction error problem, a regional integrated energy multi-timescale rolling optimised dispatch model considering supply and demand interactions is constructed to fully exploit the dispatch potential of energy storage on both the supply and demand sides to achieve economic optimisation. Finally, experimental verification is carried out, and the results show that the proposed model can better exploit the dispatching potential of electric vehicles as flexible loads and virtual energy storage, and improve the economy of system operation.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Dispatch of Park-level Integrated Energy System Considering Ladder-type Carbon Trading Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: To further reduce carbon emission level and promote operation safety of Park-level Integrated Energy System (PIES), a PIES low-carbon and robust optimization model is proposed. Firstly, a ladder-type carbon trading mechanism is developed to guide PIES to control carbon emissions. Then, taking the fluctuation of wind power output into account, a robust method considering adjustable degree of conservation is developed. Finally, by providing multiple operating scenarios, the effectiveness and usefulness of the proposed model could be demonstrated by simulation and comparison results.

articleTitle: Research on Tower Structure Optimization of Overhead Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to implement the concept of energy saving, environmental protection and efficient green construction, this paper designs and plans the tower type, and optimizes the tower structure from many aspects, including the analysis and selection of tower type, the optimization of tower mouth width and tower slope, the optimization of tower inclined material layout, the optimization of diaphragm setting, and the optimization of long and short legs, so as to fully improve the economy and safety of transmission line towers. At the same time, this paper takes the 66kV four-circuit and six-circuit transmission lines on the same tower in a certain area of Liaoning Province as an example. The actual project shows that the optimized 66kV six-circuit on the same tower can save 45 % investment compared with three double-circuit lines on the same tower, and reduce the relocation cost of the line corridor by 210 million yuan. The optimized tower has the characteristics of energy saving and environmental protection, reducing land occupation, convenient construction and saving investment, which provides some experience and reference for the optimization design of tower structure of overhead transmission lines in the future.

articleTitle: A segment location method based on positive-sequence component of full current for active distribution network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the vigorous development of new power distribution systems, a large number of distributed power sources are connected to the power distribution networks, which reduces the reliability of traditional segment location methods. In this regard, a segment location method is proposed, which is based on the waveform similarity of the amplitude of full current positive-sequence component after a fault. The Fréchet distance of the waveforms at both ends of the faulty segment is much larger than that of the non-faulty segment, which is drawn by analyzing the normalized amplitude waveforms of the full current positive-sequence component at both ends of each segment after the fault. The simulation results show that the method is not affected by the access position of the distributed power source and the fault resistances, and has strong applicability and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: A Flexible Ultraviolet Image Defect Diagnosis based on Multi-Param Fusion for External Insulation Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a flexible ultraviolet image defect diagnosis based on multi-param fusion for external insulation equipment. Different from the traditional method relying on photon number and descriptive judgment basis, the proposed method combines a variety of algorithms to automatically extract discharge information related to external insulation equipment step by step, and obtains clear diagnosis rules through a decision tree, which can effectively eliminate the influence of noise, small spot, humidity, detection distance and other factors, and provides a reliable judgment basis for the defect diagnosis of ultraviolet image. The experimental results show the performance of our method. We use 5000 images to check the equipment part detection performance, and 2000 UV fusion images to validate our diagnosis method. The experimental results show that our method can provide a useful way to quantitative diagnosis of UV image defects for external insulation equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Operation Characteristics of an AC All Electric Propulsion System without Converters
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: An novel AC all electric propulsion system without converters could increase power density and reduce the vibration noise. However, in this electric propulsion system, the cancel of converters between generator and propulsion motor made their speeds and parameters coupled directly, which resulted in the high order model of the system and strong coupling of generator and propulsion motor. The system was theoretically and mathematically modeled, and operation characteristics and function relationships of main electric variables were analyzed theoretically under different parameters matching conditions. Digital simulation on a typical electric propulsion system was carried out, the comparison of the simulated results with that of theoretical calculation verified the validity and precision of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Performance analysis for deep borehole heat exchanger heating system coupled plate heat exchanger based on TRNSYS
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The active development and utilization of deep geothermal energy to compensate energy shortage of building heating is a promising access to improve the reform of energy supply side and environmental protection. In this paper, based on the dynamic coupling characteristics between the load side, heat pump unit and buried pipe side, the model covering the deep borehole heat exchanger (DBHE) heating system coupled plate heat exchanger was established by MATLAB and TRNSYS. And the influence law of multiple factors on system was conducted to explore the operation performance of system. The study showed that with the depth of DBHE extending, increase of the buried pipe depth, the circulating fluid temperature of system increased, the average heat extraction of heating season was gradually raised, the average energy consumption of system decreased. As the inlet fluid velocity of the buried pipe increases, the average Coefficient of Performance (COP) of system gradually decrease, i.e, the system energy consumption gradually increased. The results provide a theoretical basis for the further optimization of DBHE heating system, and have great significance for practical engineering construction.

Author Keywords: Deep borehole heat exchanger heating system

articleTitle: Supplementary Damping Control of PSS and HVDC-SDC for Low-Frequency Oscillation Suppression in AC/DC Inter-connected System
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low-frequency oscillation in AC/DC inter-connected system, this paper deduces the mechanism of HVDC supplementary damping controller (HVDC-SDC) to enhance the damping of power system, and establishes the low-frequency oscillation suppression scheme in AC/DC inter-connected system. By analogy with the mechanism of power system stabilizer (PSS), this paper explains the mechanism of HVDC-SDC using the change of stator current to add damping torque for the generators. The correctness and feasibility of the mechanism is verified in AC-DC inter-connected system with mechanism derivation and simulation verification. The scheme of low-frequency oscillation suppression in AC/DC inter-connected system suitable for different power flow directions is built with both advantages of PSSs and HVDC-SDC to better improve the dynamic stability of power system.

articleTitle: Preparation of 3D interconnected porous carbon foam with rich electrochemical active site for improved electrochemical performance
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the manuscript, one highly controllable method for synthesis of porous carbon foam (PCF) through a hard-temple polymer coating approach is displayed, and the final product is directly used as the electrode material of micro-supercapacitor and secondary zinc battery. The PCF exhibits plentiful pore structure, easier ion-diffusion reactions, and richer electrochemical active sites. Due to the unique adjustable pore structure, the as-prepared PCF exhibits better cycle performance and higher specific capacity, which is concluded from serial electrochemical tests of as-assembled micro-supercapacitor and zinc-ion battery. When used as the electrode material of flexible quasi-solid-state symmetric micro-supercapacitor, the PCF exhibits a high capacity and could maintain the initial capacity after relatively long cycles. When working as the cathode of zinc-ion battery, the PCF displays an enhanced cycle stability compared to commercial active carbon.

articleTitle: Research on Frequency Regulation Strategy of DFIG-BESS System Based on Frequency Regulation Coefficient Adaptive Control
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: At present, the combined frequency regulation of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and battery energy storage system (BESS) is widely concerned. The fast frequency response control (FFRC), including droop control of DFIG and virtual inertia control of BESS, is beneficial to improve the frequency response capability of the power system. When the rotor speed (RS) of DFIG and the state of charge (SOC) of BESS are low, the FFRC cannot adjust its frequency regulation coefficient (FRC) according to the actual operating conditions of DFIG and BESS, which may reduce the RS and SOC to the minimum value, which is not conducive to the frequency safety of the power system. In view of the above problems, this paper proposes an adaptive control for the frequency regulation coefficient (FRCAC) of the DFIG augmented with BESS system (DFIG-BESS System), which multiplies the frequency regulation coefficient (FRC) of the FFRC by the frequency regulation factor (FRF) and reduces the FRF to reduce the FRC when the RS of DFIG and the SOC of BESS are low, so as to reduce the frequency regulation (FR) power of the DFIG-BESS System, which is conducive to restraining the RS of DFIG and the SOC of BESS from falling to the minimum value, which is beneficial to protect DFIG and BESS. A two-region simulation model of the power system is built in DIgSILENT, and the simulation results show that the FFRC significantly improves the frequency response capability of the DFIG-BESS System, and the FRCAC is beneficial to restrain the RS and SOC of the DFIG-BESS System from falling to the minimum value and improve the protection of the DFIG-BESS System.

articleTitle: Identification Method of the Load Component Proportion based on the Dynamic Response under Large Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the traditional load model, motor and static loads are used to represent electrical equipment. However, since the electrical equipment using power electronic interface has accounted for a large proportion at present, the load components should be divided into motor, static load and power-electronic-interfaced load. The composition of the electric load is time-varying, and mastering the proportion of different load components is the key to establish an accurate load model. The existing load component proportion identification method identifies the key parameters of the load model and motor proportion parameters under large disturbances. However, the accuracy of this method is affected by the accuracy of load model parameters; moreover, it cannot identify the proportion of three types of load components. To this end, based on the analysis of different response characteristics of motor, static load and power-electronic-interfaced load under large disturbance, this paper proposes a load component proportion identification method based on dynamic response under large disturbance. This method first determines the proportion of static load according to the drop value of active power of load during the duration of large disturbance; then, the proportion of power-electronic-interfaced load is determined according to the separation results of motor response and the highest fitting accuracy; finally, the proportion of motor load can be calculated. The case study shows that the method does not depend on other parameters in the load model and has high identification accuracy.

articleTitle: DVP Mechanism with High Renewable Penetration to Balance Power Supply and Demand
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the proposal of the goal of “Carbon Peaking and Carbon Neutralization” power supply and demand tends to be tight in the future. Power shortage will become normality, which poses greater challenges to the safe and economic operation of power systems and urgent requirement for further improving the time-of-use price and deep-valley policy (DVP), reasonably guiding users to adjust load and stagger peak power consumption with price signals. In view of the challenges brought by the renewable energy penetration. This paper proposes a DVP pricing model. This model uses Fuzzy C-Means (FCM) cluster to determine the time period division, and the non-dominated sorting Non dominated sorting genetic algorithm -II (NSGA-II) algorithm is leveraged to solve a multi-objective electricity pricing problem, then employs Bayes discrimination and load indicator changes to evaluate the feasibility of the model. The results show that the use of FCM clustering is reliable in analyzing load curve for the time period division, and through the implementation of DVP mechanism, the load rate is increased and the capacity of renewable energy consumption is improved.

articleTitle: Steady State Power System Simulation Based on GPU-Accelerated Holomorphic Embedding Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing requirements for power grid stability and reliability, improving the efficiency and accuracy of steady-state power system simulation has become an important research content. Considering the rapid development in the field of parallel computation, this paper introduced a fine-grained parallelism holomorphic embedding load flow method to accelerate steady-state power system simulation. First, GPU is selected as a computing hardware device due to its large amount of cores and shared memory. Second, this paper proposed two acceleration skills and algorithms to parallelize the holomorphic embedding load flow method.
