Compared with the original holomorphic embedding load flow method, it greatly improves efficiency while ensuring the accuracy of the calculation.

articleTitle: Output Power Decision Indices of Wind Power Generation Participating in Fast Frequency Response
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Wind power generation (WPG) is already an important power source in power systems. Whether the WPG will participate in the fast frequency response (FFR) is important to keep the frequency stability. However, the output power of WPG changes during the FFR. Accurately determining the power response of WPG is crucial for realizing the regulation goal of the frequency. A set of indices is proposed to determine the output power of the WPG participating in the FFR. Based on the proposed decision indices and the system frequency response model, the output power curve that a wind farm needs to provide under a specific frequency regulation goal can be quickly determined. The obtained output power curve provides a basis for adjusting the control parameters of wind turbine generators (WTGs) or determining the WTGs that should participate in the FFR. Finally, the case study verifies the output power decision indices proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Short-Term Reactive Load Forecasting Based on a Hybrid Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the improvement of people's living standards and the access to new energy sources such as rooftop photovoltaics, the variety of electricity consumption on the customer side has increased dramatically, placing high demands on the reactive power compensation configuration, regulation, and control capabilities at all levels of the distribution network. Predicting reactive loads directly impacts the quality of power supply and is also an integral part of reactive power optimization in the grid. With the popularity of smart energy measurement devices, large-scale historical reactive load data is uploaded to the dispatch control system. This paper proposes a hybrid reactive load prediction model based on a machine learning framework. Appropriate error parameters are selected, and the model is compared with a traditional time series prediction model to verify that the model can achieve better prediction results.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of the Influence of the Composition and Thermophysical Characteristics of Matrix Materials and Thermal Storage Materials on the Properties of a Heat Accumulator
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The article considers the influence of the composition and thermophysical characteristics of matrix materials and thermal storage materials on the properties of a heat accumulator. As an object of study, a cylindrical heat accumulator with internal fins was taken. The materials of the matrix and the heat storage substance were studied in order to determine the thermal conductivity, taking into account their interaction when working as part of a thermal accumulator. Various materials of the heat accumulator matrix were studied: aluminum, brass and bronze. The following were used as samples of heat storage materials: Na2SO4 (sodium sulfate); KCl (potassium chloride); LiF (lithium fluoride).

articleTitle: Analysis of 750V PV-Battery DC Microgrid Based on Distributed Droop Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the development of distributed power technology and power electronic converter equipment, the proportion of DC power supply and DC load in Chinese power load was increasing substantially year by year. The DC microgrid had a higher efficient, compared with the AC microgrid. And its control strategy was more worth to study. This paper studied a 750V PV-battery DC microgrid topology, and a control strategy based on the principle of distributed V-I droop control was provided. By rationally planning the voltage support range and V-I droop control of the PV converter, the battery converter and the AC-DC power converter, a stable operation of DC microgrids could be achieved. Finally, through the system modeling and simulation based on MATLAB, the validity of the system topology and its control strategy was verified.

articleTitle: The Research on Systematic Development Degree of SGLS Based on Social-Economic-Environmental Index
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The synergistic development of source-grid-load-storage (SGLS) is an important issue facing and needing to be solved for the construction of a new power system, which is an inevitable way to help achieve the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals”. The distance synergy model combining TOPSIS and gray rational theory is used to quantitatively analyze the panel data to obtain the development degree and synergy degree of social, economic and environmental systems in the development area of SGLS from 2016 to 2020. The results show that the development degree value of the whole system is low, and there is still more room to rise. The synergy degree shows a fluctuating trend, and the synergy level does not improve significantly. The economic synergy degree shows a positive correlation with the economic synergy development degree. The economic synergy plays an obvious role in promoting economic development. and the pull factors of the economic subsystem relative to the social and environmental subsystems are 1.1338 and 1.1968 respectively, indicating that the economy, as the core of development, has a significant pulling effect on other subsystems. In the future development, it is still necessary to adhere to the core of economic development to improve the comprehensive development degree of the region.

articleTitle: Research on baseline load forecasting method adapted to the characteristics of power users in urban areas
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper compares and analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of current typical baseline load forecasting algorithms. According to the characteristics of power users in urban areas in China, and comprehensively considering the applicable methods of similar historical day selection, baseline load calculation and predicted load correction in the process of baseline load forecasting, a baseline load forecasting algorithm based on grey correlation degree method and RBF radial basis function artificial neural network method is proposed. Finally, the validity and the advanced nature of the method are verified by real data test.

Author Keywords: RBF radial basis function artificial neural network

articleTitle: Research on wide-area cooperation control for renewable energy and conventional generation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Expanding the scope of renewable energy consumption and allowing surplus electricity to be consumed in a wider range is an effective way to improve the consumption capacity of renewable energy. The scale of renewable energy power generation on the DC transmission side continues to expand and will become the main power source. This puts forward new technical requirements for the consumption form of renewable energy and the control mode of transceiver unit. The transformation from local consumption at the transmitting end to joint consumption at the transmitting and receiving ends requires coordinated control of the transmitting end, receiving end and AC / DC power supply of large-scale global renewable energy consumption At the same time, the power of transmission system fluctuates greatly with the power of renewable energy, and the power of power grid at the receiving end fluctuates greatly. The control mode of the receiver unit can be extended from the locally adjusted control mode to the wide area control mode that can respond to the transmitter power fluctuation. How to improve the receiving end system's ability to receive renewable energy needs the coordination of local control and wide area control. Therefore, there is an urgent need to study the technical feasibility of global absorption of frequency modulation and peak shaving of large-scale wind power, and solve the problem of remote regulation of renewable energy by conventional power supply at the receiving end by expanding conventional power wide area control.

articleTitle: Investigating the effects of different diameter ratios on medium deep coaxial borehole heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In this paper, open source finite element simulation software OpenGeoSys is used to establish a three-dimensional heat transfer model for the medium deep coaxial borehole heat exchanger (DCBHE). Then the thermal performance test and energy consumption analysis of the DCBHE coupled heat pump heating system with different diameter ratios are investigated. Results show that with the increase of the diameter ratios of DCBHE, the heat extraction performance and the outlet temperature of DCBHE has an improvement, along with higher heating pump consumption and circulation pump consumption. Besides, there is a growth of average COP of heat pump and an obvious drop of average pump power with the increasing diameter ratios. Therefore, it can be concluded that it is necessary to comprehensively consider and choose the appropriate diameter ratio to achieve the best performance of the DCBHE.

Author Keywords: Medium deep coaxial borehole heat exchanger

articleTitle: A Third-harmonic Injection Matrix-Type Solid-State Transformer for Permanent Magnet Wind Energy Generation systems
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Conventional back-to-back converters with the power frequency transformer for permanent magnet wind energy generation systems have a simple structure. However, there are still some shortcomings such as low power density, high cost, and relatively low efficiency. To address the above issues, an active third-harmonic injection matrix-type solid-state transformer topology well-suited for the high power permanent magnet wind energy generation system is proposed in this paper. The topology has advantages such as high power density, high efficiency, as well as a simple control method. This paper analyses the operating principle and control method of the topology in detail. Finally, a 10kW simulation model verifies the effectiveness of the presented topology.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Multi-attribute Decision Options for Regional Integrated Energy Systems based on AHP-EWM Method
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Regional integrated energy systems both provide a platform for the coupled use of multiple energy sources and make it possible for users to diversify their energy needs. However, due to multiple energy output forms, it is often difficult to form a reasonable planning scheme in the planning and construction. Based on comprehensive analysis of regional integrated energy systems planning characteristics, this paper constructs an indicator system including four factors: economy, society, environment, and energy. In terms of indicator weight determination, a hierarchical analysis-entropy weighting method combining subjective and objective is proposed. A multi-attribute decision model is established to analyze each scheme's advantages and disadvantages from the identical degree, contrary degree and difference degree, so as to select the optimal decision among existing schemes. The example results verify that the proposed model can effectively facilitate the integrated energy system planning evaluation.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling of Data Centers Considering Renewable Energy Consumption and Temporalspatial Load Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the large-scale integration of renewable energy into the power grid, the demand for flexible resources on the demand side of the power grid continues to increase. As a demand-side resource with both temporal and spatial load regulation potential, the data center can absorb local new energy by adjusting the load. Therefore, this paper proposes an optimal scheduling mode for data centers that considers new energy consumption and temporal-spatial load characteristics. First, the power consumption model of the data center under various load regulation methods, new energy system model and energy storage system model are established; secondly, the load optimal scheduling of the data center is carried out with the minimum cost of the data center, and the relevant constraints are considered to absorb local renewable energy; Finally, a case study is set to evaluate indicators including renewable energy utilization and data center operating costs. It was shown that the optimal scheduling method from result can significantly decrease the data center' operating cost and improve the utilization rate of renewable energy.

articleTitle: Working Status Mining Enhanced Sequence-to-sequence Network for Non-intrusive Load Monitoring on Industrial Power Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Non-intrusive appliance load monitoring (NILM) is the process of decomposing the total energy consumption of the combined electric system into its contributing appliances. In this study, we proposed an approach by which the working status mining and sequence translation model were applied to NILM. First, we determined the working power of each appliance in different working statuses, and the combined encoding was generated to represent the working status of all electrical appliances. Subsequently, the total energy consumption signal and combined status code were trained on the sequence-to- sequence model, which considered the time correlation during operation. The constructed model integrated the time scale information and signal amplitude characteristics of electrical working status, and translated the energy consumption into a status code for load decomposition. Finally, we evaluated our model using the electrical consumption data of the gas station (the overall accuracy of load decomposition reached 87.6%), where we successfully monitored the power consumption of 12 appliances. Moreover, our solution provided a new perspective for the application of NILM in the field of industry and commerce and has the potential to be an effective energy management tool.

articleTitle: Study on Implementation Plan of Requirements for Charging Facilities International Standard Systems Comparison
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing impact on the peak valley balance of the power grid, a large number of electric vehicles connected to the urban power grid for uncontrolled charging will increase the uncertainty risk of the urban power grid. Due to the change of energy flow from one-way charging to two-way charging and discharging, the two-way interaction of vehicle networking exposes the problems that electric vehicles cannot discharge to the power grid and the risk of uncertainty increases. Improving the charge and discharge detection system is the key to ensure the safe and reliable charge and discharge of vehicle pile networking system. However, the detection system of electric vehicle charging and discharging system is extremely imperfect, which affects the internationalization of Chinese products. In order to solve the problem of lack of international certification means in China's charge discharge inspection system, it is urgent to study the construction and implementation of conformity assessment system. By studying the consistency of standard system and the differences of key technologies at home and abroad, combined with the development direction of innovative charging facility products and detection technology, this paper puts forward future oriented international standard requirements. On this basis, based on the IEC conformity assessment framework, the effects of functional performance and operating environmental factors of charging facilities are analyzed, and the IEC charging facility conformity assessment parameter system is studied and proposed. At the same time, through the research on the quantification of parameter system and the formulation of supervision cycle, starting from the internal and external environment of charging facilities, this paper studies the contribution of various factors to the quantitative index and parameter system, and puts forward a quantitative index system. The evaluation index model of charging facilities is proposed Study the calculation and analysis strategy of quantitative indicators put forward the dynamic health evaluation method of charging facilities realize the reasonable establishment of certification supervision cycle and support China's participation in international conformity assessment.

articleTitle: Steady-state Flow Analysis of District Heating System Using the Holomorphic Embedding
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: It's well recognized that integrated energy system (IES) has been paid widespread attention in recent years. District heating system (DHS) is one of the essential components of IES. In steady-state flow analysis of DHS, the conventional Newton-Rapson (NR) method and its variants may suffer from divergence, which arise the issue that if the solution exist or the method cannot find it. To overcome this drawback, the holomorphic embedding (HE) method has been proposed. This paper proposes a steady-state and linear flow model of DHS and then applies a HE-based method to solve the problem. By embedding a complex variable to the flow equations and solving the embedded equations, the solution of the problem is obtained. The case study shows that the proposed method is valid to solve the flow problem of DHS and its numerical performance is identical to the conventional NR method.

articleTitle: Development and Comparison of Two Computational Intelligence Algorithms for Electrical Load Forecasts with Multiple Time Scales
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Electricity load forecasting provides the critical information required for power institutions and authorities to develop rational, effective, and economic dispatch plans. The load forecasting at the regional power system is important for optimal management and accommodating local renewable energy sources, which is a challenging task as the demand variations are more sensitive to local weather changes (such as temperature, humidity, precipitation, and wind speed) and consumers' activities and behaviours. The paper aims to develop a new prediction method using intelligent computational algorithms. Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), a deep recurrent neural network, explores the long-term dependency of network memory sequence data to identify intrinsic variations in both horizontals (time series) and vertical (network depth) dimensions over a longer historical period. Support Vector Machine (SVM) is a typical learning method that has been successfully implemented to solve nonlinear regression and time series problems. This paper studies the two methods and adapts the two methods to become suitable algorithms for load prediction. The paper presents the algorithms, their applications and prediction results. The prediction performance is compared for using LSTM and SVM at ultra-short, short-term, medium-term, and long-term forecasting. The results show that LSTM has higher prediction accuracy than SVM in both ultra-short and short-term forecasts, but SVM is more capable of medium-term and long-term forecasting. Finally, the epoch time for LSTM and SVM is also calculated and compared.

articleTitle: Analysis on Safety and Stability Detection Between Electric Vehicle Charging Piles and Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: According to the prediction of China Electric Vehicle Association, the number of electric vehicles in China will reach 80 million by 2030. At that time, electric vehicles will provide peak shaving resources of more than 360 million KW and backup resources of 4.8 billion kwh, which is of great value to the reliable operation of power grid and the utilization of renewable energy. For the two-way charge and discharge of electric vehicles and vehicles, the limit of vehicle discharge on battery state and the control requirements of superior dispatching system need to be considered. This leads to the complex interaction process between vehicle and pile, and there is a problem that it can not be discharged normally. When the power grid needs the charging and discharging station to respond to its regulation command, it may affect the charging and discharging station's inability to respond accurately and timely. With the increasing density of charge and discharge service network, various faults that occur frequently in the process of charge and discharge will cause great harm and loss to electric vehicle users and charge and discharge operation and maintenance service network. Therefore, it is urgent to study the detection technology of vehicle pile network system and form a safe and stable detection method for vehicle pile network interoperability. It can provide technical support for the interactive charging safety of the Internet of vehicles, improve the safety and reliability of the charging and discharging process, and reduce users' worries about charging safety.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Multi-Time Scale Coordinated Economic Dispatch Model for Flexible Interconnection Low-voltage Distribution Station Areas
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper presents a data-driven multi-time scale coordinated dispatch method for flexible interconnection low-voltage distribution station areas (FDSA). Firstly, the basic structure and application prospects of FDSA are given, and an economic dispatch model for FDSA was established to minimize the total operating cost while accounting for distribution transformers(DTs), energy storage systems (ESS), distributed photovoltaic(PV) generation, flexible loads, and charging piles for electric vehicles (EV). Then, stochastic programming and robust optimization were used to address the uncertainty of PV output combined with the historical data, and a multi-timescale collaborative energy management method is provided by taking into account the flexibility of various devices. In the day-ahead stage, a stochastic-robust(SO-RO) hybrid optimization model is constructed, and a decomposition algorithm based on C&CG was used to solve the model; In the intraday stage, a two-stage stochastic rolling model is established to correct the day-ahead scheduling strategy; In the real-time stage, the deterministic optimization method is adopted to obtain scheduling strategy in seconds of the fast charging load. Finally, a numerical simulation of the flexible interconnected project in Nanjing verifies the effectiveness of the model.

Author Keywords: flexible interconnection low-voltage distribution station area

articleTitle: Faulty Feeder Detection in Distribution Systems with Resonant Grounding Based on Recognition of Data Distribution Images
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Accurate detection and timely isolation of the faulty feeder help ensure the stable operation after the occurrence of a single-phase-to-ground (SPG) fault in the distribution systems with resonant grounding. This paper introduces a novel faulty-feeder detection method based on recognition of data distribution images, and both the detection accuracy and detection efficiency of faulty-feeder identification can be improved significantly. Since the faulty feeder can be distinguished from healthy feeders by comparing the distribution features of the sampled currents, the distribution features of currents are obtained by generating a novel data distribution image, and the feature comparison is conducted by using a convolutional neural networks (CNN). The data distribution image can be acquired quickly owing to the proposed image creation method, and the established CNN with simple structure can be easily implemented. The experimental results by using PSCAD simulation and RTDS test system verify that the proposed method has good performance on detection accuracy and detection efficiency under varied fault scenarios, thus demonstrating its considerable potential for applications.

articleTitle: Analysis of Regional Photovoltaic Output Characteristics Based on Measured Operation Data
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to achieve the “dual-carbon” target, the scale of distributed new energy sources such as wind power and photovoltaic connected to the power grid is getting larger and larger, which brings great challenges to the operation control of the power grid while solving the increasing demand of load. Since distributed PV output is affected by geographical, meteorological and environmental factors, it has strong randomness, volatility and uncertainty. In this paper, firstly, the KNN algorithm and Isolated Forest algorithm are used to fuse and deal with the missing and abnormal data of the measured data. Secondly, the data mining method is studied, and the Curve Shape Clustering Algorithm based on the Elbow Criterion is proposed. Then the output characteristics of photovoltaics in terms of output size, simultaneous rate, and volatility are analyzed. Finally, combined with the actual measured operation data in a certain area, the characteristics and change rules of photovoltaic output are pointed out, which provides an important reference for the regional power grid dispatchers to reasonably arrange the daily new energy dispatch amount.

articleTitle: Economic Evaluation of Voltage Sags Mitigation Scheme Based on Decoupled Net Present Value
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Under the pressing demand for voltage sags mitigation, the effect of voltage sags mitigation and its economic benefits will directly affect the selection of voltage sags mitigation scheme by investors. Therefore, it is necessary to evaluate the economic benefits of the voltage sags mitigation scheme. The Net Present Value (NPV) method is the most commonly used economic evaluation method, in which the future net cash flow of the project is discounted to its present value at a certain discount rate for comparison, but the selection of the discount rate is difficult. The traditional method uses only the risk-free rate for discounting. As for long-term infrastructure investment projects in the category of voltage sags mitigation program, the project risk has a significant impact on the results of its economic evaluation, and it is not feasible to use only the risk-free rate for discounting. This paper introduces the influence of risk factors on the economic benefits of the project, and uses the Decoupled Net Present Value (DNPV) method to evaluate the economics of the voltage sags mitigation scheme, and takes the mitigation scheme at the node with severe voltage sags in the IEEE-30 network as an example to evaluate the economic benefits of the scheme, and compares it with the traditional NPV method, and verifies that the evaluation results of the DNPV method are more reliable than the traditional NPV method after considering the risk factors.

articleTitle: Design of Peak-Valley TOU Customized Package Based on Choice Behavior of Users
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In the spot market environment, the wholesale price fluctuates in real time and provides a stronger time-of-use price signal for the retail market. It is necessary to combine the construction of spot market with the optimization of package in the retail market to fully respond to the development of the power market. Therefore, based on the basic ideas of design of retail package, the time-of-use pricing model is established by taking the maximization of profit and the minimization of risk as the objective function, taking into account the market share, user's independent choice constraint and risk constraint. Among them, the user's independent choice constraint analyzes the probability of the user choosing the package and the size of electricity consumption adjusted by users from the perspective of user utility value. The simulation analysis takes three typical users of steady type, peak meeting type and peak avoiding type as the target, and the result shows that electricity retailers can encourage users to actively adjust their electricity consumption by designing peakvalley time-of-use pricing based on users' choice behavior, so as to improve their own income and achieve a win-win situation for themselves and users.

articleTitle: An Extended GRA-EDAS with Combination Weighting Method for Power Quality Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of the complicated ranking process, a large amount of calculation, and inability to identify the advantages and disadvantages of particular indicators of traditional power quality total assessment methods, a comprehensive power quality assessment method with Extended GRA-EDAS algorithm is proposed. Firstly, according to the load and scenario characteristics of the microgrid, the power quality index system is constructed; secondly, the entropy weight method and the analytic hierarchy process are used to determine the weight of the index system; the idea of gray relation analysis is introduced in the EDAS algorithm, and the evaluation object is sorted in combination with the index weight, and finally, the evaluation object is classified. The numerical results verify the correctness and advantages of the proposed method in this paper, and the power quality of each evaluation object can be correctly sorted by file.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Fault Diagnosis Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The traditional grid fault diagnosis has the following problems: the lack of grid structure information, feature input depends on manual experience, and the model logic is complex. For the above problems, this paper studies a deep learning-based grid fault diagnosis technology. Firstly, an adaptive grid advanced feature extraction method is designed, as well as a depth iterative network for the grid structure for extracting the structure-related abstract characteristics. Then design a grid fault diagnosis model (AFD_SL) based on supervision learning and a power grid fault diagnosis model (AFD_RL) based on strengthening learning. Among them, the AFD_SL is designed with a way one by one to design the diagnose model, which is suitable for power grid fault diagnosis scene with sufficient label data; AFD_RL transforms troubleshooting problems into a sequential decision-making process, which is suitable for power grid fault diagnostics scenes with insufficient label data. The experimental results show that the grid fault diagnosis method designed herein has a good mode l portability and robustness while better handling multiple fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Interactions Between the Ownership and the Market Behavior of Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Energy storage can provide multiple auxiliary services such as inertia support and frequency response, which has become the key to ensure the low-carbon and safe operation of the new power system. However, it remains an open question as how the storage operated by private merchants will be scheduled and whether this profit-seeking behavior can lead to the loss of system efficiency. This paper seeks to evaluate the impact of storage ownership on the market electricity price, welfare transfer and market behavior. A bi-level model is for-mulated to capture the interaction between the storage ownership and its market behavior. The results indicated that the general arbitrage be-havior of energy storage can contribute to peak shaving. However, when considering the joint participation of energy storage and different types of generating units such as renewable units or conventional units, its strategic behavior will lead to the transfer of social welfare as well as the system efficiency losses.

articleTitle: Research on Power Network Maintenance Plan Optimization based on Improved Second-order Oscillation PSO
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: The arrangement of maintenance plan of transmission network is related to the safe and stable operation of power network and the orderly development of maintenance work. However, at present, the maintenance planning process in China depends on the overall arrangement of special maintenance personnel, which is difficult to adapt to the operation control needs of large power networks. To improve the maintenance efficiency, this paper first establishes an optimization model of the practical transmission network maintenance plan, and puts forward the optimization goal of the shortest maintenance outage time. Secondly, according to the actual needs of power network maintenance work, the optimization program of power transmission network maintenance plan based on second-order oscillating particle swarm optimization algorithm is developed. The optimization adjustment and safety check of maintenance and outage plan are realized by using massive power network operation mode data, initial maintenance plan and other multisource information. Finally, the effectiveness and superiority of the model and method selected in this paper is analyzed and verified with an example of optimized maintenance plan arrangement in a province, which realizes the intelligent optimization decision of power transmission network maintenance and outage.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive evaluation of distribution network's acceptance of electric vehicle charging load
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to actively respond to the construction of the national “dual carbon” goal, the application scale of electric vehicles (EV) continues to expand. The disorderly charging behaviors of large-scale EV will bring various impacts on the planning and operation of the power system. Firstly, an evaluation index system covering the operation status of the distribution network (DN) and the serviceability of the charging station is established to address the charging decision of electric vehicles. Secondly, a comprehensive subjective and objective weighting method combining entropy weighting method and hierarchical analysis method is used to calculate the weights of index and criterion layers respectively, and the fuzzy synthetic evaluation method of hierarchical recursion is adopted to evaluate the ability of the power distribution system to receive EV. Finally, based on the predicted EV charging load, the EVs are set to connected to the typical IEEE33 power grid in different ways in multiple scenarios, and the optimal plan for the distribution network to accept electric vehicles is evaluated according to the established evaluation index system and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method.

articleTitle: Quantitative Intelligent Evaluation of Transient Power Angle Stability based on Cluster Grouping
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that it is difficult to achieve the quantitative evaluation of transient power angle stability based on artificial intelligence, a quantitative intelligent evaluation method of transient power angle stability based on cluster grouping is proposed. Firstly, the key features of transient power angle stability are selected by the method of comprehensive physical mechanism and data mining. According to the difference requirement parameters of the key features of the train samples, the similar samples are minimized and clustered into groups. The center sample of each group is determined based on the comprehensive minimum of the stable mode difference index. Based on each group of center samples, a transient power angle stability margin estimation model is established and parameters are optimized by linear programming. Determine the effective group to which the new mode belongs by the effective mode distance of each group of samples. Use the model corresponding to each effective group to estimate the margin of the new mode, and take the minimum value of the estimated margin of all effective groups as the estimated value of the transient stability margin of the new mode to realize quantitative intelligent evaluation of transient power angle stability. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by an example of power grid.

articleTitle: Estimation of Reasonable Line Loss in Low Power and Light Load Station Area Based on Robust Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: In order to actively respond to the “double carbon” policy, reduce energy consumption and improve the economic operation of small power and light load stations. In the operation of the power system, a set of benchmark indicators for line loss in a light load station area is established to provide “rulers” for line loss in various station areas, which can indicate the direction of loss reduction in the light load station area. We propose a reasonable line loss estimation approach that is based on robust neural networks for low power and light load station areas, and the minimum redundancy maximum relevance algorithm is suggested to screen the line loss rate factors on the basis of the actual operation of the light load station area and to evaluate the effectiveness of the relevant features based on the forward search strategy. The constructed model can calculate a reasonable line loss numerical value and confirm a sensible upper limit of power loss for the lightly loaded station area. The validity of the improved algorithm is demonstrated by using a sample of station data from a city in Jiangsu Province.

Author Keywords: Small power and light load platform area

articleTitle: Operation Status Evaluation of Distribution Automation System Based on Q-rung Orthopair Fuzzy Set
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A great lot of work has been conducted to do academic researches on the operation status of distribution equipment, but a comprehensive evaluation to describe the operation status of distribution automation system is lacking. Based on the acknowledged network structure of distribution automation systems, the evaluation model of system operation status is constructed from three aspects: master station, distribution terminals and communication system. An expert decision matrix is set up by using q-rung orthopair fuzzy set. The subjective weights of evaluation indexes are acquired by combining information aggregation operator and hierarchical analysis method. The objective weight is calculated by one of objective weighting method, called entropy weight method. The operation status is evaluated by combining comprehensive weights and membership functions of evaluation indexes. The effectiveness and practicability of methods mentioned are verified by the operational data of a distribution automation system in Yangzhou.

articleTitle: Multi-label text mining method for electrical equipment defects based on improved CNN-SVM
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: A large number of descriptive transmission and transformation equipment defect records have been accumulated in the work of power grid informatization, and the category imbalance and label symbiosis phenomenon directly affect the multi-label classification effect of the documents. There is a large amount of complex information in the existing power equipment defect record text, and the same text information corresponds to multiple data labels, so the data is highly correlated. It is necessary to comprehensively extract the text information features and to mine the correlation between the global tags from the graph structure data. To this end, this paper proposes a multi-label text classification model (CS-GAT) that fuses convolutional neural network-self-attention mechanism (CNN-SAM) and graph attention network (GAT). The scheme first considers the professional word classification method in the field of power system, and performs text preprocessing on the sentences in the defect record text. The word2vec model is used to map words to a high-dimensional feature space to form distributed word vectors; and meanwhile, the correlation between different text labels is transformed into an edge-weighted graph with global information, and the multi-layer graph attention mechanism is used to automatically learn the relationship between different labels. And then interact with the contextual semantic information of the text to obtain the global label information with the semantic relationship of the text. The example analysis shows that the multilabel classification scheme proposed in this paper has better classification effect, can achieve automatic accurate and efficient classification of power equipment defect texts, and can effectively improve the automatic classification performance of power texts.

articleTitle: Physical Meanings Analysis of Price Multiplicity Based on Mortzkin's Theorem
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the physical meanings of price multiplicity in real-time market, i.e. the characteristics of market clearing model when price multiplicity happens, in detail. Based on the allowable variation ranges of the corresponding multipliers, buses and transmission lines are divided into three types respectively. The classification is further applied to the formula of locational marginal price, and the variation equations are obtained. By adopting Mortzkin's theorem, the physical meanings of price multiplicity at quasi-marginal buses and non-marginal buses are derived. When price multiplicity happens at a bus, the variations of the objective function of market clearing model for an extra injection and extraction power at this bus must be unequal. In particular, for quasi-marginal buses, the price multiplicity also means that there are no marginal units or marginal loads at these buses in all the optimal solutions of the clearing problem. Numerical examples are provided to illustrate and verify the above theoretical analyses.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Resilience Assessment Based on Load Shedding Methodology
publicationTitle: 2022 Power System and Green Energy Conference (PSGEC)
abstract: With the increasing awareness of environmental protection, integrated energy systems have gained an increasingly attention. However, the significance of resilience of integrated energy systems has been increasingly emphasized at a time when extreme events occur frequently. Therefore, this paper focuses on the concept of resilience. Firstly, the resilience evaluation index of integrated energy system is established. The index considers the damage frequency of each device in the system, the scale of load loss caused by failure and the time of the disaster. Subsequently, this paper gives the resilience evaluation process based on the simulation of the load loss of the system in a disaster. By improving the enumeration method, the accuracy of the overall resilience assessment when enumerating low-order cases is improved. The effectiveness of this method is tested in an actual case. Finally, this paper proposes a specific process for resilience strengthening of the system using this resilience assessment method and verifies that these methods can effectively improve the system resilience.
